title: ARC-AGI-3: A New Challenge for Frontier Agentic Intelligence
summary: We introduce ARC-AGI-3, an interactive benchmark for studying agentic intelligence through novel, abstract, turn-based environments in which agents must explore, infer goals, build internal models of environment dynamics, and plan effective action sequences without explicit instructions. Like its predecessors ARC-AGI-1 and 2, ARC-AGI-3 focuses entirely on evaluating fluid adaptive efficiency on novel tasks, while avoiding language and external knowledge. ARC-AGI-3 environments only leverage Core Knowledge priors and are difficulty-calibrated via extensive testing with human test-takers. Our testing shows humans can solve 100% of the environments, in contrast to frontier AI systems which, as of March 2026, score below 1%. In this paper, we present the benchmark design, its efficiency-based scoring framework grounded in human action baselines, and the methodology used to construct, validate, and calibrate the environments.

AI.tldr: ARC-AGI-3是一个交互式基准测试，用于通过新颖的、抽象的、回合制环境研究智能体智能，要求智能体在没有明确指令的情况下探索、推断目标、建立环境动态内部模型并规划有效行动序列。
AI.motivation: 研究智能体智能，评估智能体在全新任务上的流体自适应效率，避免语言和外部知识的影响，专注于核心知识先验。
AI.method: 设计基于核心知识先验的回合制环境，通过大量人类测试者进行难度校准，建立基于人类行动基准的效率评分框架，并开发环境构建、验证和校准的方法论。
AI.result: 人类能够解决100%的环境，而截至2026年3月，前沿AI系统的得分低于1%，显示出人类与当前AI系统在智能体智能方面的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: ARC-AGI-3提供了一个有效的基准测试框架，能够评估智能体在全新任务上的自适应能力，揭示了当前AI系统在智能体智能方面仍有巨大提升空间。

title: When Is Collective Intelligence a Lottery? Multi-Agent Scaling Laws for Memetic Drift in LLMs
summary: Multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that shape consequential decisions, both directly and indirectly. Yet it remains unclear whether their outcomes reflect collective reasoning, systematic bias, or mere chance. Recent work has sharpened this question with naming games, showing that even when no individual agent favors any label a priori, populations rapidly break symmetry and reach consensus. Here, we reveal the mechanism by introducing a minimal model, Quantized Simplex Gossip (QSG), and trace the microscopic origin of this agreement to mutual in-context learning. In QSG, agents maintain internal belief states but learn from one another's sampled outputs, so one agent's arbitrary choice becomes the next agent's evidence and can compound toward agreement. By analogy with neutral evolution, we call this sampling-driven regime memetic drift. QSG predicts a crossover from a drift-dominated regime, where consensus is effectively a lottery, to a selection regime, where weak biases are amplified and shape the outcome. We derive scaling laws for drift-induced polarization as a function of population size, communication bandwidth, in-context adaptation rate, and agents' internal uncertainty, and we validate them in both QSG simulations and naming-game experiments with LLM populations. Together, these results provide a framework for studying the collective mechanisms of social representation formation in multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了量化单纯形闲谈模型，揭示了多智能体系统中通过相互上下文学习达成共识的微观机制，将这种采样驱动的过程称为模因漂移，并推导了漂移诱导极化的标度定律。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于大语言模型的多智能体系统越来越多地应用于重要决策场景，但其结果究竟反映集体推理、系统性偏见还是纯粹偶然仍不清楚。近期命名游戏研究表明，即使个体智能体没有先验偏好，群体也能迅速打破对称性达成共识，这需要机制解释。
AI.method: 提出了量化单纯形闲谈模型，智能体维护内部信念状态但相互学习采样输出，一个智能体的任意选择成为下一个智能体的证据，从而促成共识。通过类比中性进化，将这种采样驱动机制称为模因漂移。
AI.result: 模型预测了从漂移主导机制（共识类似抽签）到选择机制（微弱偏见被放大）的交叉转变。推导了漂移诱导极化随群体规模、通信带宽、上下文适应率和智能体内部不确定性的标度定律，并在QSG模拟和LLM命名游戏实验中验证。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为研究多智能体系统中社会表征形成的集体机制提供了理论框架，揭示了通过相互上下文学习达成共识的微观起源。

title: AutoSAM: an Agentic Framework for Automating Input File Generation for the SAM Code with Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: In the design and safety analysis of advanced reactor systems, constructing input files for system-level thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) remains a labor-intensive task. Analysts must extract and reconcile design data from heterogeneous engineering documents and manually translate it into solver-specific syntax. In this paper, we present AutoSAM, an agentic framework that automates SAM input file generation. The framework combines a large language model agent with retrieval-augmented generation over the solver's user guide and theory manual, together with specialized tools for analyzing PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and text files. AutoSAM ingests unstructured engineering documents, including system diagrams, design reports, and data tables, extracts simulation-relevant parameters into a human-auditable intermediate representation, and synthesizes validated, solver-compatible input decks. Its multimodal retrieval pipeline integrates scientific text extraction, vision-based figure interpretation, semantic embedding, and query answering. We evaluate AutoSAM on four case studies of increasing complexity: a single-pipe steady-state model, a solid-fuel channel with temperature reactivity feedback, the Advanced Burner Test Reactor core, and the Molten Salt Reactor Experiment primary loop. Across all cases, the agent produces runnable SAM models consistent with expected thermal-hydraulic behavior while explicitly identifying missing data and labeling assumed values. The framework achieves 100% utilization of structured inputs, about 88% extraction from PDF text, and 100% completeness in vision-based geometric extraction. These results demonstrate a practical path toward prompt-driven reactor modeling, in which analysts provide system descriptions and supporting documentation while the agent translates them into transparent, and executable, SAM simulations.

AI.tldr: AutoSAM是一个基于大语言模型的智能框架，能够自动从非结构化工程文档中提取参数并生成SAM热工水力代码的输入文件，显著减少了手动建模的工作量。
AI.motivation: 在先进反应堆系统的设计和安全分析中，为系统级热工水力代码（如SAM）构建输入文件仍然是一项劳动密集型任务。分析人员需要从异构的工程文档中提取和协调设计数据，并手动将其转换为求解器特定的语法。
AI.method: AutoSAM结合了大语言模型代理和检索增强生成技术，利用求解器的用户指南和理论手册，并配备专门工具来分析PDF、图像、电子表格和文本文件。该框架采用多模态检索管道，集成了科学文本提取、基于视觉的图形解释、语义嵌入和查询回答功能。
AI.result: 在四个复杂度递增的案例研究中，AutoSAM生成了可运行的SAM模型，其热工水力行为与预期一致。该框架实现了结构化输入的100%利用率，PDF文本提取约88%的准确率，以及基于视觉的几何提取100%的完整性。
AI.conclusion: AutoSAM展示了一条实用的反应堆建模路径，使分析人员能够提供系统描述和支持文档，而代理则将其转换为透明且可执行的SAM模拟，显著提高了建模效率和准确性。

title: Trust as Monitoring: Evolutionary Dynamics of User Trust and AI Developer Behaviour
summary: AI safety is an increasingly urgent concern as the capabilities and adoption of AI systems grow. Existing evolutionary models of AI governance have primarily examined incentives for safe development and effective regulation, typically representing users' trust as a one-shot adoption choice rather than as a dynamic, evolving process shaped by repeated interactions. We instead model trust as reduced monitoring in a repeated, asymmetric interaction between users and AI developers, where checking AI behaviour is costly. Using evolutionary game theory, we study how user trust strategies and developer choices between safe (compliant) and unsafe (non-compliant) AI co-evolve under different levels of monitoring cost and institutional regimes. We complement the infinite-population replicator analysis with stochastic finite-population dynamics and reinforcement learning (Q-learning) simulations. Across these approaches, we find three robust long-run regimes: no adoption with unsafe development, unsafe but widely adopted systems, and safe systems that are widely adopted. Only the last is desirable, and it arises when penalties for unsafe behaviour exceed the extra cost of safety and users can still afford to monitor at least occasionally. Our results formally support governance proposals that emphasise transparency, low-cost monitoring, and meaningful sanctions, and they show that neither regulation alone nor blind user trust is sufficient to prevent evolutionary drift towards unsafe or low-adoption outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用进化博弈论建模用户与AI开发者之间的信任动态，发现只有低成本监控和有效惩罚才能实现安全AI的广泛采用
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理模型将用户信任视为一次性选择，而非动态演化过程。随着AI能力增强和安全问题日益紧迫，需要更真实地建模信任作为减少监控的动态过程
AI.method: 使用进化博弈论，将信任建模为重复非对称交互中的减少监控行为。结合无限种群复制者动态、随机有限种群动态和强化学习(Q-learning)模拟，分析不同监控成本和制度下的演化
AI.result: 发现三个稳定的长期演化机制：1)不安全开发且无采用；2)不安全但广泛采用；3)安全且广泛采用。只有第三种是理想的，需要惩罚超过安全成本且用户能负担偶尔监控
AI.conclusion: 研究支持强调透明度、低成本监控和有效制裁的治理方案。单独监管或盲目用户信任都不足以防止向不安全或低采用结果的演化漂移

title: When Consistency Becomes Bias: Interviewer Effects in Semi-Structured Clinical Interviews
summary: Automatic depression detection from doctor-patient conversations has gained momentum thanks to the availability of public corpora and advances in language modeling. However, interpretability remains limited: strong performance is often reported without revealing what drives predictions. We analyze three datasets: ANDROIDS, DAIC-WOZ, E-DAIC and identify a systematic bias from interviewer prompts in semi-structured interviews. Models trained on interviewer turns exploit fixed prompts and positions to distinguish depressed from control subjects, often achieving high classification scores without using participant language. Restricting models to participant utterances distributes decision evidence more broadly and reflects genuine linguistic cues. While semi-structured protocols ensure consistency, including interviewer prompts inflates performance by leveraging script artifacts. Our results highlight a cross-dataset, architecture-agnostic bias and emphasize the need for analyses that localize decision evidence by time and speaker to ensure models learn from participants' language.

AI.tldr: 研究发现抑郁症自动检测模型在医患对话中存在系统性偏见，模型主要依赖访谈者的固定提问模式而非患者语言来区分抑郁与非抑郁被试，导致性能虚高。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于医患对话的自动抑郁症检测研究取得进展，但模型可解释性有限，现有研究往往报告高性能却未揭示预测的真正驱动因素。研究者希望探究模型是否真正学习了患者的语言特征。
AI.method: 分析三个公开数据集（ANDROIDS、DAIC-WOZ、E-DAIC），识别半结构化访谈中的系统性偏见。通过比较模型在完整对话与仅患者话语上的表现，评估模型是否依赖访谈者提示语而非患者语言特征。
AI.result: 模型在完整对话中利用访谈者的固定提问模式和位置来区分抑郁与控制组被试，即使不使用参与者语言也能获得高分类分数。限制模型仅使用患者话语后，决策证据分布更广泛且反映真实的语言线索。
AI.conclusion: 半结构化访谈协议虽然确保一致性，但包含访谈者提示会因利用脚本人工痕迹而虚增性能。研究揭示了跨数据集、架构无关的系统性偏见，强调需要通过时间和说话者定位决策证据的分析，确保模型真正从患者语言中学习。

title: Formal Semantics for Agentic Tool Protocols: A Process Calculus Approach
summary: The emergence of large language model agents capable of invoking external tools has created urgent need for formal verification of agent protocols. Two paradigms dominate this space: Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD), a research framework for zero-shot API generalization, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an industry standard for agent-tool integration. While both enable dynamic service discovery through schema descriptions, their formal relationship remains unexplored. Building on prior work establishing the conceptual convergence of these paradigms, we present the first process calculus formalization of SGD and MCP, proving they are structurally bisimilar under a well-defined mapping Phi. However, we demonstrate that the reverse mapping Phi^{-1} is partial and lossy, revealing critical gaps in MCP's expressivity. Through bidirectional analysis, we identify five principles -- semantic completeness, explicit action boundaries, failure mode documentation, progressive disclosure compatibility, and inter-tool relationship declaration -- as necessary and sufficient conditions for full behavioral equivalence. We formalize these principles as type-system extensions MCP+, proving MCP+ is isomorphic to SGD. Our work provides the first formal foundation for verified agent systems and establishes schema quality as a provable safety property.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次为SGD和MCP两种代理协议提供了进程演算形式化，证明它们在特定映射下结构双相似，但反向映射存在部分性和信息损失，揭示了MCP的表达能力缺陷，并提出了MCP+扩展来实现与SGD的完全行为等价。
AI.motivation: 随着能够调用外部工具的大型语言模型代理的出现，对代理协议进行形式化验证的需求变得迫切。SGD和MCP是两种主导范式，虽然都通过模式描述实现动态服务发现，但它们的正式关系尚未被探索。本文旨在建立这两种范式的形式化基础，为验证代理系统提供理论支持。
AI.method: 基于先前关于这两种范式概念收敛的工作，首次为SGD和MCP提供进程演算形式化。证明在明确定义的映射Φ下，两者是结构双相似的。通过双向分析发现反向映射Φ^{-1}是部分且有损的，揭示了MCP在表达能力上的关键缺陷。提出了五个原则作为完全行为等价的必要充分条件，并将这些原则形式化为类型系统扩展MCP+。
AI.result: 证明了SGD和MCP在映射Φ下是结构双相似的，但反向映射是部分且有损的，表明MCP的表达能力存在不足。通过识别五个关键原则，开发了MCP+扩展，并证明了MCP+与SGD是同构的。这为模式质量作为可证明的安全属性提供了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次为验证代理系统提供了形式化基础，建立了模式质量作为可证明安全属性的概念。通过形式化分析揭示了MCP的表达能力限制，并提出了MCP+扩展来实现与SGD的完全行为等价。这项工作为构建安全可靠的代理系统提供了理论框架和实用指导。

title: Demystifying When Pruning Works via Representation Hierarchies
summary: Network pruning, which removes less important parameters or architectures, is often expected to improve efficiency while preserving performance. However, this expectation does not consistently hold across language tasks: pruned models can perform well on non-generative tasks but frequently fail in generative settings. To understand this discrepancy, we analyze network pruning from a representation-hierarchy perspective, decomposing the internal computation of language models into three sequential spaces: embedding (hidden representations), logit (pre-softmax outputs), and probability (post-softmax distributions). We find that representations in the embedding and logit spaces are largely robust to pruning-induced perturbations. However, the nonlinear transformation from logits to probabilities amplifies these deviations, which accumulate across time steps and lead to substantial degradation during generation. In contrast, the stability of the categorical-token probability subspace, together with the robustness of the embedding space, supports the effectiveness of pruning for non-generative tasks such as retrieval and multiple-choice selection. Our analysis disentangles the effects of pruning across tasks and provides practical guidance for its application. Code is available at https://github.com/CASE-Lab-UMD/Pruning-on-Representations

AI.tldr: 该论文从表示层次视角分析网络剪枝，发现剪枝对嵌入和logit空间影响较小，但logit到概率的非线性转换会放大偏差，导致生成任务性能下降，而非生成任务则相对稳定。
AI.motivation: 网络剪枝在语言任务中表现不一致：剪枝模型在非生成任务上表现良好，但在生成任务中经常失败。为了理解这种差异，需要从表示层次角度分析剪枝的影响机制。
AI.method: 从表示层次视角分析网络剪枝，将语言模型的内部计算分解为三个顺序空间：嵌入空间（隐藏表示）、logit空间（softmax前输出）和概率空间（softmax后分布）。分析剪枝引起的扰动在不同空间中的传播和放大效应。
AI.result: 嵌入和logit空间的表示对剪枝引起的扰动具有鲁棒性，但从logit到概率的非线性转换会放大这些偏差。这些偏差在时间步上累积，导致生成任务性能显著下降。然而，分类-标记概率子空间的稳定性与嵌入空间的鲁棒性共同支持了剪枝在检索和多选等非生成任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该分析揭示了剪枝在不同任务中的影响机制差异，为剪枝的实际应用提供了指导。剪枝适用于非生成任务，但在生成任务中需要特别关注概率转换阶段的偏差累积问题。

title: From Weights to Concepts: Data-Free Interpretability of CLIP via Singular Vector Decomposition
summary: As vision-language models are deployed at scale, understanding their internal mechanisms becomes increasingly critical. Existing interpretability methods predominantly rely on activations, making them dataset-dependent, vulnerable to data bias, and often restricted to coarse head-level explanations. We introduce SITH (Semantic Inspection of Transformer Heads), a fully data-free, training-free framework that directly analyzes CLIP's vision transformer in weight space. For each attention head, we decompose its value-output matrix into singular vectors and interpret each one via COMP (Coherent Orthogonal Matching Pursuit), a new algorithm that explains them as sparse, semantically coherent combinations of human-interpretable concepts. We show that SITH yields coherent, faithful intra-head explanations, validated through reconstruction fidelity and interpretability experiments. This allows us to use SITH for precise, interpretable weight-space model edits that amplify or suppress specific concepts, improving downstream performance without retraining. Furthermore, we use SITH to study model adaptation, showing how fine-tuning primarily reweights a stable semantic basis rather than learning entirely new features.

AI.tldr: SITH是一个无需数据、无需训练的可解释性框架，通过分析CLIP视觉transformer的权重空间来理解注意力头的语义机制，支持精确的模型编辑和适应研究。
AI.motivation: 现有基于激活的可解释性方法存在数据集依赖、易受数据偏见影响、只能提供粗粒度头部解释等问题，需要更直接、数据无关的方法来理解视觉语言模型的内部机制。
AI.method: SITH框架直接分析CLIP视觉transformer的权重空间，将每个注意力头的值输出矩阵分解为奇异向量，通过COMP算法将其解释为稀疏、语义连贯的人类可解释概念组合。
AI.result: SITH能够产生连贯、忠实的内在头部解释，通过重建保真度和可解释性实验验证。支持精确、可解释的权重空间模型编辑，无需重新训练即可改善下游性能。还能研究模型适应过程，显示微调主要是重新加权稳定的语义基础而非学习全新特征。
AI.conclusion: SITH提供了一种数据无关、训练无关的方法来深入理解视觉语言模型的内部语义机制，支持精确模型编辑和模型适应研究，为模型可解释性提供了新视角。

title: Supervising Ralph Wiggum: Exploring a Metacognitive Co-Regulation Agentic AI Loop for Engineering Design
summary: The engineering design research community has studied agentic AI systems that use Large Language Model (LLM) agents to automate the engineering design process. However, these systems are prone to some of the same pathologies that plague humans. Just as human designers, LLM design agents can fixate on existing paradigms and fail to explore alternatives when solving design challenges, potentially leading to suboptimal solutions. In this work, we propose (1) a novel Self-Regulation Loop (SRL), in which the Design Agent self-regulates and explicitly monitors its own metacognition, and (2) a novel Co-Regulation Design Agentic Loop (CRDAL), in which a Metacognitive Co-Regulation Agent assists the Design Agent in metacognition to mitigate design fixation, thereby improving system performance for engineering design tasks. In the battery pack design problem examined here, we found that the novel CRDAL system generates designs with better performance, without significantly increasing the computational cost, compared to a plain Ralph Wiggum Loop (RWL) and the metacognitively self-assessing Self-Regulation Loop (SRL). Also, we found that the CRDAL system navigated through the latent design space more effectively than both SRL and RWL. However, the SRL did not generate designs with significantly better performance than RWL, even though it explored a different region of the design space. The proposed system architectures and findings of this work provide practical implications for future development of agentic AI systems for engineering design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种新型AI代理系统架构（SRL和CRDAL），通过元认知调节机制缓解工程设计中的设计固化问题，在电池包设计任务中CRDAL系统表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的AI设计代理系统存在与人类设计师类似的设计固化问题，即过度依赖现有范式而未能充分探索替代方案，可能导致次优解决方案。
AI.method: 提出两种新架构：1）自调节循环（SRL），设计代理自我调节并显式监控自身元认知；2）协同调节设计代理循环（CRDAL），引入元认知协同调节代理协助设计代理进行元认知调节。
AI.result: 在电池包设计问题中，CRDAL系统生成的设计性能优于普通RWL和SRL系统，且未显著增加计算成本；CRDAL在潜在设计空间中的导航效果也优于SRL和RWL；但SRL相比RWL并未显著提升设计性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的系统架构为未来工程设计领域代理AI系统开发提供了实用启示，特别是CRDAL系统通过元认知协同调节机制有效缓解设计固化问题。

title: Fine-Tuning A Large Language Model for Systematic Review Screening
summary: Systematic reviews traditionally have taken considerable amounts of human time and energy to complete, in part due to the extensive number of titles and abstracts that must be reviewed for potential inclusion. Recently, researchers have begun to explore how to use large language models (LLMs) to make this process more efficient. However, research to date has shown inconsistent results. We posit this is because prompting alone may not provide sufficient context for the model(s) to perform well. In this study, we fine-tune a small 1.2 billion parameter open-weight LLM specifically for study screening in the context of a systematic review in which humans rated more than 8500 titles and abstracts for potential inclusion. Our results showed strong performance improvements from the fine-tuned model, with the weighted F1 score improving 80.79% compared to the base model. When run on the full dataset of 8,277 studies, the fine-tuned model had 86.40% agreement with the human coder, a 91.18% true positive rate, a 86.38% true negative rate, and perfect agreement across multiple inference runs. Taken together, our results show that there is promise for fine-tuning LLMs for title and abstract screening in large-scale systematic reviews.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过微调小型开源大语言模型，显著提升了系统综述中文献标题和摘要筛选的效率与准确性
AI.motivation: 传统系统综述需要大量人工时间筛选文献，现有基于大语言模型的自动化方法效果不稳定，研究者认为仅靠提示工程可能无法提供足够上下文信息
AI.method: 在人类专家对8500多篇文献进行标注的基础上，对1.2亿参数的开源大语言模型进行微调，专门用于系统综述中的研究筛选任务
AI.result: 微调后模型性能显著提升：加权F1分数比基础模型提高80.79%；在8277篇文献测试中，与人工标注一致性达86.40%，真阳性率91.18%，真阴性率86.38%，多次推理结果完全一致
AI.conclusion: 通过专门微调的大语言模型在系统综述的文献筛选任务中表现出色，为大规模系统综述的自动化处理提供了有前景的解决方案

title: ReDiPrune: Relevance-Diversity Pre-Projection Token Pruning for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
summary: Recent multimodal large language models are computationally expensive because Transformers must process a large number of visual tokens. We present \textbf{ReDiPrune}, a training-free token pruning method applied before the vision-language projector, where visual features remain rich and discriminative. Unlike post-projection pruning methods that operate on compressed representations, ReDiPrune selects informative tokens directly from vision encoder outputs, preserving fine-grained spatial and semantic cues. Each token is scored by a lightweight rule that jointly consider text-conditioned relevance and max-min diversity, ensuring the selected tokens are both query-relevant and non-redundant. ReDiPrune is fully plug-and-play, requiring no retraining or architectural modifications, and can be seamlessly inserted between the encoder and projector. Across four video and five image benchmarks, it consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. For example, on EgoSchema with LLaVA-NeXT-Video-7B, retaining only 15\% of visual tokens yields a +2.0\% absolute accuracy gain while reducing computation by more than $6\times$ in TFLOPs. Code is available at https://github.com/UA-CVML/ReDiPrune.

AI.tldr: ReDiPrune是一种无需训练的可视化token剪枝方法，在视觉-语言投影器之前选择信息丰富的token，通过联合考虑文本相关性和多样性来提升准确率-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型计算成本高，因为Transformer需要处理大量视觉token。现有方法通常在投影后剪枝，这会损失细粒度空间和语义信息。
AI.method: 在视觉编码器输出和投影器之间插入ReDiPrune，使用轻量级规则为每个token评分，联合考虑文本条件相关性和最大-最小多样性，选择既与查询相关又不冗余的token。
AI.result: 在4个视频和5个图像基准测试中，ReDiPrune持续改善准确率-效率权衡。例如在EgoSchema上，仅保留15%视觉token就能获得+2.0%绝对准确率提升，同时减少6倍以上的TFLOPs计算量。
AI.conclusion: ReDiPrune是一种即插即用的训练免费token剪枝方法，可直接应用于视觉编码器输出，在保持细粒度信息的同时显著提升多模态大语言模型的效率。

title: ReLope: KL-Regularized LoRA Probes for Multimodal LLM Routing
summary: Routing has emerged as a promising strategy for balancing performance and cost in large language model (LLM) systems that combine lightweight models with powerful but expensive large models. Recent studies show that \emph{probe routing}, which predicts the correctness of a small model using its hidden states, provides an effective solution in text-only LLMs. However, we observe that these probes degrade substantially when applied to multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). Through empirical analysis, we find that the presence of visual inputs weakens the separability of correctness signals in hidden states, making them harder to extract using standard probe designs. To address this challenge, we introduce two complementary approaches for improving probe routing in MLLMs. First, we propose the \emph{Attention Probe}, which aggregates hidden states from the preceding layer based on attention scores to recover distributed correctness signals. Second, we present the \emph{KL-Regularized LoRA Probe (ReLope)}, which inserts a lightweight LoRA adapter and applies a KL regularizer to learn routing-aware representations. Comprehensive experiments show that our methods consistently outperform baselines, suggesting that improving the quality of hidden states is key to effective routing in MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Spinozaaa/ReLope.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型中的路由问题，提出两种改进探针路由的方法：注意力探针和KL正则化LoRA探针，以解决视觉输入导致隐藏状态可分性下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 路由策略在结合轻量模型与昂贵大模型的LLM系统中展现出平衡性能与成本的潜力。现有探针路由方法在纯文本LLMs中有效，但在多模态LLMs中性能显著下降。研究发现视觉输入会削弱隐藏状态中正确性信号的可分性，使标准探针设计难以提取这些信号。
AI.method: 提出两种互补方法：1) 注意力探针：基于注意力分数聚合前一层隐藏状态以恢复分布式正确性信号；2) KL正则化LoRA探针：插入轻量级LoRA适配器并应用KL正则化器来学习路由感知表示。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，所提方法在多个基准测试中一致优于基线方法，证明了改进隐藏状态质量对MLLMs中有效路由的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 改进隐藏状态质量是多模态大语言模型中实现有效路由的关键。提出的注意力探针和KL正则化LoRA探针方法能够显著提升探针路由性能，为平衡MLLM系统性能与成本提供了有效解决方案。

title: Resisting Humanization: Ethical Front-End Design Choices in AI for Sensitive Contexts
comment: Accepted at the Proceedings of the CHI 2026 Workshop: Ethics at the Front-End
summary: Ethical debates in AI have primarily focused on back-end issues such as data governance, model training, and algorithmic decision-making. Less attention has been paid to the ethical significance of front-end design choices, such as the interaction and representation-based elements through which users interact with AI systems. This gap is particularly significant for Conversational User Interfaces (CUI) based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems, where humanizing design elements such as dialogue-based interaction, emotive language, personality modes, and anthropomorphic metaphors are increasingly prevalent. This work argues that humanization in AI front-end design is a value-driven choice that profoundly shapes users' mental models, trust calibration, and behavioral responses. Drawing on research in human-computer interaction (HCI), conversational AI, and value-sensitive design, we examine how interfaces can play a central role in misaligning user expectations, fostering misplaced trust, and subtly undermining user autonomy, especially in vulnerable contexts. To ground this analysis, we discuss two AI systems developed by Chayn, a nonprofit organization supporting survivors of gender-based violence. Chayn is extremely cautious when building AI that interacts with or impacts survivors by operationalizing their trauma-informed design principles. This Chayn case study illustrates how ethical considerations can motivate principled restraint in interface design, challenging engagement-based norms in contemporary AI products. We argue that ethical front-end AI design is a form of procedural ethics, enacted through interaction choices rather than embedded solely in system logic.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨AI前端设计伦理，特别是对话式用户界面中拟人化设计的伦理影响，通过Chayn组织的案例说明伦理考量如何指导界面设计选择
AI.motivation: 当前AI伦理讨论主要关注后端问题（数据治理、模型训练等），而前端设计选择（交互方式、表现形式）的伦理意义被忽视，特别是在对话式用户界面中，拟人化设计元素日益普遍，需要研究其对用户心理模型、信任校准和行为反应的影响
AI.method: 结合人机交互、对话式AI和价值敏感设计的研究，分析界面如何影响用户期望、信任和自主性；通过Chayn组织（支持性别暴力幸存者的非营利机构）的两个AI系统案例，展示创伤知情设计原则如何指导伦理界面设计
AI.result: AI前端设计中的人类化是价值驱动的选择，深刻影响用户心理模型和信任；界面可能在脆弱情境下误导用户期望、培养错误信任并削弱用户自主性；Chayn案例表明伦理考量可以推动基于原则的设计克制，挑战当前AI产品中以参与度为导向的设计规范
AI.conclusion: 伦理的AI前端设计是一种程序性伦理，通过交互选择而非仅仅系统逻辑来体现；需要更重视前端设计选择的伦理意义，特别是在涉及脆弱用户的对话式界面中

title: Enhancing Structured Meaning Representations with Aspect Classification
summary: To fully capture the meaning of a sentence, semantic representations should encode aspect, which describes the internal temporal structure of events. In graph-based meaning representation frameworks such as Uniform Meaning Representations (UMR), aspect lets one know how events unfold over time, including distinctions such as states, activities, and completed events. Despite its importance, aspect remains sparsely annotated across semantic meaning representation frameworks. This has, in turn, hindered not only current manual annotation, but also the development of automatic systems capable of predicting aspectual information. In this paper, we introduce a new dataset of English sentences annotated with UMR aspect labels over Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graphs that lack the feature. We describe the annotation scheme and guidelines used to label eventive predicates according to the UMR aspect lattice, as well as the annotation pipeline used to ensure consistency and quality across annotators through a multi-step adjudication process. To demonstrate the utility of our dataset for future automation, we present baseline experiments using three modeling approaches. Our results establish initial benchmarks for automatic UMR aspect prediction and provide a foundation for integrating aspect into semantic meaning representations more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个英语句子UMR体貌标注数据集，用于在缺乏该特征的AMR图上标注体貌信息，并建立了自动预测的基线模型。
AI.motivation: 体貌对于完整理解句子意义至关重要，它能描述事件内部的时间结构。然而，在语义表示框架中体貌标注稀疏，这阻碍了人工标注和自动预测系统的发展。
AI.method: 创建了英语句子UMR体貌标注数据集，制定了基于UMR体貌格的标注方案和指南，采用多步骤裁决流程确保标注一致性和质量，并使用三种建模方法进行基线实验。
AI.result: 建立了首个英语UMR体貌标注数据集，为自动UMR体貌预测设定了初始基准，为更广泛地将体貌整合到语义表示中奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了体貌标注的空白，为未来自动化系统开发提供了重要资源，有助于推动语义表示中体貌信息的整合和应用。

title: SentinelAI: A Multi-Agent Framework for Structuring and Linking NG9-1-1 Emergency Incident Data
summary: Emergency response systems generate data from many agencies and systems. In practice, correlating and updating this information across sources in a way that aligns with Next Generation 9-1-1 data standards remains challenging. Ideally, this data should be treated as a continuous stream of operational updates, where new facts are integrated immediately to provide a timely and unified view of an evolving incident. This paper presents SentinelAI, a data integration and standardization framework for transforming emergency communications into standardized, machine-readable datasets that support integration, composite incident construction, and cross-source reasoning. SentinelAI implements a scalable processing pipeline composed of specialized agents. The EIDO Agent ingests raw communications and produces NENA-compliant Emergency Incident Data Object JSON.

AI.tldr: SentinelAI是一个用于紧急响应系统的数据集成和标准化框架，将紧急通信转换为符合NENA标准的机器可读数据集，支持集成、复合事件构建和跨源推理。
AI.motivation: 紧急响应系统从多个机构和系统生成数据，但在实践中，按照下一代911数据标准跨源关联和更新这些信息仍然具有挑战性。理想情况下，这些数据应被视为连续的操作更新流，新事实被立即整合以提供对不断演变事件的及时统一视图。
AI.method: SentinelAI实现了一个由专门代理组成的可扩展处理流水线。EIDO代理摄取原始通信并生成符合NENA标准的紧急事件数据对象JSON。
AI.result: 该框架能够将紧急通信转换为标准化的机器可读数据集，支持集成、复合事件构建和跨源推理。
AI.conclusion: SentinelAI提供了一个有效的数据集成和标准化解决方案，解决了紧急响应系统中跨源数据关联和更新的挑战，实现了对紧急事件的及时统一视图。

title: How Far Are Vision-Language Models from Constructing the Real World? A Benchmark for Physical Generative Reasoning
summary: The physical world is not merely visual; it is governed by rigorous structural and procedural constraints. Yet, the evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) remains heavily skewed toward perceptual realism, prioritizing the generation of visually plausible 3D layouts, shapes, and appearances. Current benchmarks rarely test whether models grasp the step-by-step processes and physical dependencies required to actually build these artifacts, a capability essential for automating design-to-construction pipelines. To address this, we introduce DreamHouse, a novel benchmark for physical generative reasoning: the capacity to synthesize artifacts that concurrently satisfy geometric, structural, constructability, and code-compliance constraints. We ground this benchmark in residential timber-frame construction, a domain with fully codified engineering standards and objectively verifiable correctness. We curate over 26,000 structures spanning 13 architectural styles, ach verified to construction-document standards (LOD 350) and develop a deterministic 10-test structural validation framework. Unlike static benchmarks that assess only final outputs, DreamHouse supports iterative agentic interaction. Models observe intermediate build states, generate construction actions, and receive structured environmental feedback, enabling a fine-grained evaluation of planning, structural reasoning, and self-correction. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs reveal substantial capability gaps that are largely invisible on existing leaderboards. These findings establish physical validity as a critical evaluation axis orthogonal to visual realism, highlighting physical generative reasoning as a distinct and underdeveloped frontier in multimodal intelligence. Available at https://luluyuyuyang.github.io/dreamhouse

AI.tldr: DreamHouse是一个评估视觉语言模型物理生成推理能力的新基准，专注于住宅木结构建筑的几何、结构、可建造性和规范合规性约束，支持迭代式智能体交互评估。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型评估过于偏向感知真实性，主要关注生成视觉上合理的3D布局、形状和外观，但很少测试模型是否理解构建这些人工制品所需的逐步过程和物理依赖关系，而这对于自动化设计到施工流程至关重要。
AI.method: 基于住宅木结构建筑领域（具有完全编码的工程标准和可客观验证的正确性）构建基准，收集了13种建筑风格的26,000多个结构，均达到施工文件标准（LOD 350），并开发了确定性的10项结构验证框架。支持迭代式智能体交互：模型观察中间构建状态，生成施工动作，接收结构化环境反馈。
AI.result: 对最先进的视觉语言模型进行广泛实验，揭示了现有排行榜上基本不可见的显著能力差距。这些发现确立了物理有效性作为与视觉真实性正交的关键评估维度。
AI.conclusion: 物理生成推理是多模态智能中一个独特且未充分发展的前沿领域，DreamHouse基准突出了物理有效性作为关键评估维度的重要性，与视觉真实性形成正交关系。

title: Prune as You Generate: Online Rollout Pruning for Faster and Better RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, methods such as GRPO and DAPO suffer from substantial computational cost, since they rely on sampling many rollouts for each prompt. Moreover, in RLVR the relative advantage is often sparse: many samples become nearly all-correct or all-incorrect, yielding low within-group reward variance and thus weak learning signals. In this paper, we introduce arrol (Accelerating RLVR via online Rollout Pruning), an online rollout pruning method that prunes rollouts during generation while explicitly steering the surviving ones more correctness-balanced to enhance learning signals. Specifically, arrol trains a lightweight quality head on-the-fly to predict the success probability of partial rollouts and uses it to make early pruning decisions. The learned quality head can further weigh candidates to improve inference accuracy during test-time scaling. To improve efficiency, we present a system design that prunes rollouts inside the inference engine and re-batches the remaining ones for log-probability computation and policy updates. Across GRPO and DAPO on Qwen-3 and LLaMA-3.2 models (1B-8B), arrol improves average accuracy by +2.30 to +2.99 while achieving up to 1.7x training speedup, and yielding up to +8.33 additional gains in average accuracy in test-time scaling. The code is available at https://github.com/Hsu1023/ARRoL.

AI.tldr: ARRoL是一种在线剪枝方法，通过训练轻量级质量头预测部分生成的成功概率，在生成过程中剪枝低质量rollout，提高RLVR训练效率和效果。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法（如GRPO和DAPO）存在两个主要问题：1）计算成本高，需要为每个提示采样大量rollout；2）相对优势稀疏，许多样本变得几乎全对或全错，导致组内奖励方差低，学习信号弱。
AI.method: 提出ARRoL（Accelerating RLVR via online Rollout Pruning）方法：1）训练轻量级质量头实时预测部分rollout的成功概率；2）在生成过程中进行早期剪枝决策；3）系统设计在推理引擎内部剪枝rollout，并重新批处理剩余样本进行对数概率计算和政策更新；4）质量头还可用于测试时缩放中加权候选答案以提高推理准确性。
AI.result: 在Qwen-3和LLaMA-3.2模型（1B-8B）上，ARRoL在GRPO和DAPO上平均准确率提升+2.30到+2.99，训练速度最高提升1.7倍，测试时缩放中平均准确率额外提升最高+8.33。
AI.conclusion: ARRoL通过在线rollout剪枝有效解决了RLVR方法的计算效率和稀疏奖励问题，在保持甚至提升准确率的同时显著加速训练，并在测试时缩放中带来额外收益。

title: LLaVA-LE: Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Lunar Exploration
comment: Accepted in AI4Space Workshop CVPR2026. Website: https://osupcvlab.github.io/LLaVA-LE/, Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pcvlab/lucid
summary: Recent advances in multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled joint reasoning over visual and textual information, yet their application to planetary science remains largely unexplored. A key hindrance is the absence of large-scale datasets that pair real planetary imagery with detailed scientific descriptions. In this work, we introduce LLaVA-LE (Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Lunar Exploration), a vision-language model specialized for lunar surface and subsurface characterization. To enable this capability, we curate a new large-scale multimodal lunar dataset, LUCID (LUnar Caption Image Dataset) consisting of 96k high-resolution panchromatic images paired with detailed captions describing lunar terrain characteristics, and 81k question-answer (QA) pairs derived from approximately 20k images in the LUCID dataset. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune LLaVA using a two-stage training curriculum: (1) concept alignment for domain-specific terrain description, and (2) instruction-tuned visual question answering. We further design evaluation benchmarks spanning multiple levels of reasoning complexity relevant to lunar terrain analysis. Evaluated against GPT and Gemini judges, LLaVA-LE achieves a 3.3x overall performance gain over Base LLaVA and 2.1x over our Stage 1 model, with a reasoning score of 1.070, exceeding the judge's own reference score, highlighting the effectiveness of domain-specific multimodal data and instruction tuning to advance VLMs in planetary exploration. Code is available at https://github.com/OSUPCVLab/LLaVA-LE.

AI.tldr: LLaVA-LE是一个专门用于月球表面和次表面特征分析的多模态视觉语言模型，通过构建大规模月球数据集LUCID并进行两阶段训练，在月球地形分析任务上显著超越了基础模型。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态视觉语言模型在视觉和文本联合推理方面取得了进展，但在行星科学领域的应用仍未被充分探索。主要障碍是缺乏将真实行星图像与详细科学描述配对的大规模数据集。
AI.method: 1. 构建LUCID数据集：包含96k高分辨率全色图像配详细地形描述，以及81k个QA对；2. 两阶段训练：第一阶段进行领域特定地形描述的概念对齐，第二阶段进行指令调优的视觉问答训练。
AI.result: LLaVA-LE相比基础LLaVA实现了3.3倍的整体性能提升，相比第一阶段模型提升2.1倍，推理得分达到1.070，超过了评判者自身的参考分数，证明了领域特定多模态数据和指令调优的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的多模态数据和指令调优能够显著推进视觉语言模型在行星探索中的应用，LLaVA-LE为月球地形分析提供了有效的工具，代码已开源。

title: On the Foundations of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
summary:
We prove that platform-deterministic inference is necessary and sufficient for
  trustworthy AI. We formalize this as the Determinism Thesis and introduce trust
  entropy to quantify the cost of non-determinism, proving that verification failure
  probability equals 1 - 2^{-H_T} exactly. We prove a Determinism-Verification
  Collapse: verification under determinism requires O(1) hash comparison; without it,
  the verifier faces an intractable membership problem. IEEE 754 floating-point
  arithmetic fundamentally violates the determinism requirement. We resolve this by
  constructing a pure integer inference engine that achieves bitwise identical output
  across ARM and x86. In 82 cross-architecture tests on models up to 6.7B parameters,
  we observe zero hash mismatches. Four geographically distributed nodes produce
  identical outputs, verified by 356 on-chain attestation transactions. Every major
  trust property of AI systems (fairness, robustness, privacy, safety, alignment)
  presupposes platform determinism. Our system, 99,000 lines of Rust deployed across
  three continents, establishes that AI trust is a question of arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 平台确定性推理是可信AI的必要且充分条件，通过纯整数推理引擎实现跨架构比特级一致性输出
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统缺乏平台确定性，IEEE 754浮点运算存在架构差异，导致验证困难，无法确保AI系统的可信属性（公平性、鲁棒性、隐私、安全性、对齐性）
AI.method: 提出确定性论题，引入信任熵量化非确定性成本；构建纯整数推理引擎，实现ARM和x86架构间的比特级相同输出；进行跨架构测试和地理分布式验证
AI.result: 在82个跨架构测试中（模型参数达67亿），观察到零哈希不匹配；四个地理分布式节点产生相同输出，通过356个链上认证交易验证；99,000行Rust代码部署在三大洲
AI.conclusion: AI可信性本质上是算术问题，平台确定性是实现可信AI的基础，验证失败概率精确等于1 - 2^{-H_T}，确定性条件下验证仅需O(1)哈希比较

title: LogSigma at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Uncertainty-Weighted Multitask Learning for Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: This paper describes LogSigma, our system for SemEval-2026 Task 3: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DimABSA). Unlike traditional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA), which predicts discrete sentiment labels, DimABSA requires predicting continuous Valence and Arousal (VA) scores on a 1-9 scale. A central challenge is that Valence and Arousal differ in prediction difficulty across languages and domains. We address this using learned homoscedastic uncertainty, where the model learns task-specific log-variance parameters to automatically balance each regression objective during training. Combined with language-specific encoders and multi-seed ensembling, LogSigma achieves 1st place on five datasets across both tracks. The learned variance weights vary substantially across languages due to differing Valence-Arousal difficulty profiles-from 0.66x for German to 2.18x for English-demonstrating that optimal task balancing is language-dependent and cannot be determined a priori.

AI.tldr: LogSigma系统在SemEval-2026 Task 3中采用学习同方差不确定性方法，通过自动平衡不同语言的效价-唤醒度预测难度，在五个数据集上获得第一名。
AI.motivation: 传统方面情感分析预测离散标签，而维度方面情感分析需要预测1-9尺度的连续效价和唤醒度分数。不同语言和领域中，效价和唤醒度的预测难度存在差异，需要解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 使用学习同方差不确定性方法，模型学习任务特定的对数方差参数，在训练过程中自动平衡每个回归目标。结合语言特定编码器和多种子集成技术。
AI.result: LogSigma在五个数据集的两个赛道中均获得第一名。学习到的方差权重在不同语言间差异显著（从德语的0.66倍到英语的2.18倍），表明最优任务平衡是语言依赖的，无法先验确定。
AI.conclusion: 学习同方差不确定性方法能有效处理维度方面情感分析中不同语言效价-唤醒度预测难度的差异，实现自动任务平衡，在多语言场景中表现优异。

title: LogitScope: A Framework for Analyzing LLM Uncertainty Through Information Metrics
summary: Understanding and quantifying uncertainty in large language model (LLM) outputs is critical for reliable deployment. However, traditional evaluation approaches provide limited insight into model confidence at individual token positions during generation. To address this issue, we introduce LogitScope, a lightweight framework for analyzing LLM uncertainty through token-level information metrics computed from probability distributions. By measuring metrics such as entropy and varentropy at each generation step, LogitScope reveals patterns in model confidence, identifies potential hallucinations, and exposes decision points where models exhibit high uncertainty, all without requiring labeled data or semantic interpretation. We demonstrate LogitScope's utility across diverse applications including uncertainty quantification, model behavior analysis, and production monitoring. The framework is model-agnostic, computationally efficient through lazy evaluation, and compatible with any HuggingFace model, enabling both researchers and practitioners to inspect LLM behavior during inference.

AI.tldr: LogitScope是一个轻量级框架，通过从概率分布计算token级别的信息度量来分析LLM不确定性，无需标注数据或语义解释
AI.motivation: 传统评估方法对模型在生成过程中各个token位置的置信度提供有限洞察，需要更好的不确定性量化方法来可靠部署LLM
AI.method: 引入LogitScope框架，通过在每个生成步骤计算熵和变熵等信息度量来分析token级别的LLM不确定性，采用惰性评估提高计算效率
AI.result: LogitScope能够揭示模型置信度模式、识别潜在幻觉、暴露高不确定性决策点，在不确定性量化、模型行为分析和生产监控等应用中表现出实用性
AI.conclusion: LogitScope是一个模型无关、计算高效的框架，兼容任何HuggingFace模型，使研究人员和从业者能够在推理过程中检查LLM行为

title: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
summary: Recent work shows that standard greedy-decoding extraction methods for quantifying memorization in LLMs miss how extraction risk varies across sequences. Probabilistic extraction -- computing the probability of generating a target suffix given a prefix under a decoding scheme -- addresses this, but is tractable only for verbatim memorization, missing near-verbatim instances that pose similar privacy and copyright risks. Quantifying near-verbatim extraction risk is expensive: the set of near-verbatim suffixes is combinatorially large, and reliable Monte Carlo (MC) estimation can require ~100,000 samples per sequence. To mitigate this cost, we introduce decoding-constrained beam search, which yields deterministic lower bounds on near-verbatim extraction risk at a cost comparable to ~20 MC samples per sequence. Across experiments, our approach surfaces information invisible to verbatim methods: many more extractable sequences, substantially larger per-sequence extraction mass, and patterns in how near-verbatim extraction risk manifests across model sizes and types of text.

AI.tldr: 提出解码约束束搜索方法，以低成本获得近逐字提取风险的下界，相比传统方法能发现更多可提取序列和更大的提取质量
AI.motivation: 现有LLM记忆量化方法存在局限：标准贪婪解码方法无法捕捉序列间提取风险的差异；概率提取方法仅适用于逐字记忆，忽略了具有相似隐私和版权风险的近逐字实例；而量化近逐字提取风险的计算成本极高
AI.method: 提出解码约束束搜索方法，通过确定性下界来量化近逐字提取风险，成本仅相当于约20个蒙特卡洛样本，远低于传统方法需要的约100,000个样本
AI.result: 该方法揭示了传统逐字方法无法发现的信息：更多可提取序列、显著更大的每序列提取质量，以及近逐字提取风险在不同模型规模和文本类型中的表现模式
AI.conclusion: 解码约束束搜索为高效量化LLM中的近逐字提取风险提供了实用解决方案，有助于更好地评估隐私和版权风险

title: Decoding Market Emotions in Cryptocurrency Tweets via Predictive Statement Classification with Machine Learning and Transformers
summary: The growing prominence of cryptocurrencies has triggered widespread public engagement and increased speculative activity, particularly on social media platforms. This study introduces a novel classification framework for identifying predictive statements in cryptocurrency-related tweets, focusing on five popular cryptocurrencies: Cardano, Matic, Binance, Ripple, and Fantom. The classification process is divided into two stages: Task 1 involves binary classification to distinguish between Predictive and Non-Predictive statements. Tweets identified as Predictive proceed to Task 2, where they are further categorized as Incremental, Decremental, or Neutral. To build a robust dataset, we combined manual and GPT-based annotation methods and utilized SenticNet to extract emotion features corresponding to each prediction category. To address class imbalance, GPT-generated paraphrasing was employed for data augmentation. We evaluated a wide range of machine learning, deep learning, and transformer-based models across both tasks. The results show that GPT-based balancing significantly enhanced model performance, with transformer models achieving the highest F1-score in Task 1, while traditional machine learning models performed best in Task 2. Furthermore, our emotion analysis revealed distinct emotional patterns associated with each prediction category across the different cryptocurrencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新颖的分类框架，用于识别加密货币相关推文中的预测性陈述，通过两阶段分类（预测性/非预测性，以及增量/减量/中性预测）和情感特征分析，结合GPT增强的数据平衡方法，评估了多种机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: 随着加密货币的日益普及，社交媒体上出现了大量投机活动和预测性讨论。然而，缺乏系统的方法来识别和分析这些预测性陈述，特别是针对不同加密货币的预测类型和情感特征。
AI.method: 采用两阶段分类框架：任务1是二元分类（预测性vs非预测性），任务2对预测性推文进一步分类为增量、减量或中性预测。结合人工和GPT标注构建数据集，使用SenticNet提取情感特征，通过GPT生成的改写进行数据增强以解决类别不平衡问题。评估了多种机器学习、深度学习和基于Transformer的模型。
AI.result: GPT平衡方法显著提升了模型性能：在任务1中，Transformer模型获得最高的F1分数；在任务2中，传统机器学习模型表现最佳。情感分析揭示了不同加密货币的预测类别具有明显的情感模式差异。
AI.conclusion: 该分类框架能有效识别加密货币推文中的预测性陈述，GPT增强的数据平衡策略改善了模型性能，情感分析为理解加密货币市场情绪提供了新视角，对市场分析和风险管理具有实际应用价值。

title: Toward domain-specific machine translation and quality estimation systems
summary: Machine Translation (MT) and Quality Estimation (QE) perform well in general domains but degrade under domain mismatch. This dissertation studies how to adapt MT and QE systems to specialized domains through a set of data-focused contributions. Chapter 2 presents a similarity-based data selection method for MT. Small, targeted in-domain subsets outperform much larger generic datasets and reach strong translation quality at lower computational cost. Chapter 3 introduces a staged QE training pipeline that combines domain adaptation with lightweight data augmentation. The method improves performance across domains, languages, and resource settings, including zero-shot and cross-lingual cases. Chapter 4 studies the role of subword tokenization and vocabulary in fine-tuning. Aligned tokenization-vocabulary setups lead to stable training and better translation quality, while mismatched configurations reduce performance. Chapter 5 proposes a QE-guided in-context learning method for large language models. QE models select examples that improve translation quality without parameter updates and outperform standard retrieval methods. The approach also supports a reference-free setup, reducing reliance on a single reference set. These results show that domain adaptation depends on data selection, representation, and efficient adaptation strategies. The dissertation provides methods for building MT and QE systems that perform reliably in domain-specific settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何通过数据选择、表示和高效适应策略，将机器翻译和质量评估系统适配到专业领域，提出了多种方法提升领域特定场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译和质量评估系统在通用领域表现良好，但在领域不匹配时性能下降。需要研究如何将这些系统适配到专业领域，提高在特定领域中的可靠性和性能。
AI.method: 1. 基于相似性的机器翻译数据选择方法；2. 结合领域适应和轻量数据增强的分阶段质量评估训练流程；3. 研究子词分词和词汇表在微调中的作用；4. 提出质量评估引导的上下文学习方法，用于大型语言模型。
AI.result: 1. 小规模目标领域子集优于大规模通用数据集，以更低计算成本达到强翻译质量；2. 质量评估方法在跨领域、语言和资源设置中表现提升；3. 对齐的分词-词汇表设置带来稳定训练和更好翻译质量；4. 质量评估引导的上下文学习方法无需参数更新即可提升翻译质量，优于标准检索方法。
AI.conclusion: 领域适应依赖于数据选择、表示和高效适应策略。该论文提供了构建在领域特定设置中可靠运行的机器翻译和质量评估系统的方法。

title: Scalable Object Relation Encoding for Better 3D Spatial Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning focuses on locating target objects based on spatial relations in 3D scenes, which plays a crucial role in developing intelligent embodied agents. Due to the limited availability of 3D scene-language paired data, it is challenging to train models with strong reasoning ability from scratch. Previous approaches have attempted to inject 3D scene representations into the input space of Large Language Models (LLMs) and leverage the pretrained comprehension and reasoning abilities for spatial reasoning. However, models encoding absolute positions struggle to extract spatial relations from prematurely fused features, while methods explicitly encoding all spatial relations (which is quadratic in the number of objects) as input tokens suffer from poor scalability. To address these limitations, we propose QuatRoPE, a novel positional embedding method with an input length that is linear to the number of objects, and explicitly calculates pairwise spatial relations through the dot product in attention layers. QuatRoPE's holistic vector encoding of 3D coordinates guarantees a high degree of spatial consistency, maintaining fidelity to the scene's geometric integrity. Additionally, we introduce the Isolated Gated RoPE Extension (IGRE), which effectively limits QuatRoPE's influence to object-related tokens, thereby minimizing interference with the LLM's existing positional embeddings and maintaining the LLM's original capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approaches. The code and data are available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/QuatRoPE.

AI.tldr: QuatRoPE是一种新颖的位置编码方法，通过注意力层的点积显式计算成对空间关系，输入长度与对象数量呈线性关系，解决了3D空间推理中的可扩展性问题。
AI.motivation: 由于3D场景-语言配对数据有限，从头训练具有强大推理能力的模型具有挑战性。现有方法要么难以从过早融合的特征中提取空间关系，要么因显式编码所有空间关系（对象数量的二次方）而导致可扩展性差。
AI.method: 提出QuatRoPE位置编码方法，输入长度与对象数量呈线性关系，通过注意力层的点积显式计算成对空间关系。同时引入Isolated Gated RoPE Extension (IGRE)，将QuatRoPE的影响限制在对象相关标记上，最小化对LLM现有位置编码的干扰。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明了该方法的有效性。QuatRoPE的3D坐标整体向量编码保证了高度的空间一致性，保持了场景几何完整性的保真度。
AI.conclusion: QuatRoPE解决了3D空间推理中的可扩展性问题，同时保持了LLM的原始能力，为开发智能具身代理提供了有效的空间推理解决方案。

title: FinMCP-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Real-World Financial Tool Use under the Model Context Protocol
summary: This paper introduces \textbf{FinMCP-Bench}, a novel benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) in solving real-world financial problems through tool invocation of financial model context protocols. FinMCP-Bench contains 613 samples spanning 10 main scenarios and 33 sub-scenarios, featuring both real and synthetic user queries to ensure diversity and authenticity. It incorporates 65 real financial MCPs and three types of samples, single tool, multi-tool, and multi-turn, allowing evaluation of models across different levels of task complexity. Using this benchmark, we systematically assess a range of mainstream LLMs and propose metrics that explicitly measure tool invocation accuracy and reasoning capabilities. FinMCP-Bench provides a standardized, practical, and challenging testbed for advancing research on financial LLM agents.

AI.tldr: FinMCP-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型通过金融模型上下文协议工具调用解决现实金融问题能力的新型基准测试，包含613个样本、10个主要场景和33个子场景。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏标准化的基准来评估大语言模型在真实金融场景中通过工具调用解决实际问题的能力，需要建立一个全面、实用且具有挑战性的测试平台来推动金融LLM智能体的研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含613个样本的基准数据集，涵盖10个主要场景和33个子场景，包含真实和合成的用户查询。整合了65个真实金融MCPs，设计了单工具、多工具和多轮对话三种样本类型，并提出了专门衡量工具调用准确性和推理能力的评估指标。
AI.result: FinMCP-Bench提供了一个标准化、实用且具有挑战性的测试平台，能够系统评估主流大语言模型在金融工具调用任务中的表现，通过明确的指标衡量模型的工具调用准确性和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: FinMCP-Bench为金融大语言模型智能体的研究提供了重要的基准测试工具，有助于推动该领域的发展，通过标准化的评估促进模型在真实金融问题解决能力方面的进步。

title: LLM-Driven Reasoning for Constraint-Aware Feature Selection in Industrial Systems
summary: Feature selection is a crucial step in large-scale industrial machine learning systems, directly affecting model accuracy, efficiency, and maintainability. Traditional feature selection methods rely on labeled data and statistical heuristics, making them difficult to apply in production environments where labeled data are limited and multiple operational constraints must be satisfied. To address this, we propose Model Feature Agent (MoFA), a model-driven framework that performs sequential, reasoning-based feature selection using both semantic and quantitative feature information. MoFA incorporates feature definitions, importance scores, correlations, and metadata (e.g., feature groups or types) into structured prompts and selects features through interpretable, constraint-aware reasoning. We evaluate MoFA in three real-world industrial applications: (1) True Interest and Time-Worthiness Prediction, where it improves accuracy while reducing feature group complexity, (2) Value Model Enhancement, where it discovers high-order interaction terms that yield substantial engagement gains in online experiments, and (3) Notification Behavior Prediction, where it selects compact, high-value feature subsets that improve both model accuracy and inference efficiency. Together, these results demonstrate the practicality and effectiveness of LLM-based reasoning for feature selection in real production systems.

AI.tldr: 提出MoFA框架，利用大语言模型进行基于推理的特征选择，在工业应用中提升模型精度和效率
AI.motivation: 传统特征选择方法依赖标注数据和统计启发式，难以应用于标注数据有限且需满足多种操作约束的生产环境
AI.method: 提出Model Feature Agent (MoFA)框架，利用语义和定量特征信息进行顺序推理的特征选择，整合特征定义、重要性分数、相关性及元数据到结构化提示中
AI.result: 在三个真实工业应用中验证：1) 提升预测精度同时降低特征组复杂度；2) 发现高阶交互项带来显著参与度提升；3) 选择紧凑高价值特征子集同时提升精度和推理效率
AI.conclusion: 基于大语言模型推理的特征选择方法在实际生产系统中具有实用性和有效性

title: Is Geometry Enough? An Evaluation of Landmark-Based Gaze Estimation
summary: Appearance-based gaze estimation frequently relies on deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). These models are accurate, but computationally expensive and act as "black boxes", offering little interpretability. Geometric methods based on facial landmarks are a lightweight alternative, but their performance limits and generalization capabilities remain underexplored in modern benchmarks. In this study, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of landmark-based gaze estimation. We introduce a standardized pipeline to extract and normalize landmarks from three large-scale datasets (Gaze360, ETH-XGaze, and GazeGene) and train lightweight regression models, specifically Extreme Gradient Boosted trees and two neural architectures: a holistic Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and a siamese MLP designed to capture binocular geometry. We find that landmark-based models exhibit lower performance in within-domain evaluation, likely due to noise introduced into the datasets by the landmark detector. Nevertheless, in cross-domain evaluation, the proposed MLP architectures show generalization capabilities comparable to those of ResNet18 baselines. These findings suggest that sparse geometric features encode sufficient information for robust gaze estimation, paving the way for efficient, interpretable, and privacy-friendly edge applications. The source code and generated landmark-based datasets are available at https://github.com/daniele-agostinelli/LandmarkGaze.git.

AI.tldr: 基于面部关键点的几何方法在视线估计中表现出与深度CNN相当的泛化能力，同时具有计算效率高、可解释性强的优势
AI.motivation: 基于CNN的视线估计方法虽然准确但计算成本高且缺乏可解释性，而基于面部关键点的几何方法作为轻量级替代方案，其性能极限和泛化能力在现代基准测试中尚未得到充分探索
AI.method: 引入标准化流程从三个大规模数据集提取和归一化关键点，训练轻量级回归模型：极端梯度提升树、整体MLP和设计用于捕捉双目几何的孪生MLP
AI.result: 关键点模型在域内评估中性能较低（可能由于关键点检测器引入的噪声），但在跨域评估中，提出的MLP架构显示出与ResNet18基线相当的泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 稀疏几何特征编码了足够的信息用于鲁棒的视线估计，为高效、可解释且保护隐私的边缘应用铺平了道路

title: Exons-Detect: Identifying and Amplifying Exonic Tokens via Hidden-State Discrepancy for Robust AI-Generated Text Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models has increasingly blurred the boundary between human-written and AI-generated text, raising societal risks such as misinformation dissemination, authorship ambiguity, and threats to intellectual property rights. These concerns highlight the urgent need for effective and reliable detection methods. While existing training-free approaches often achieve strong performance by aggregating token-level signals into a global score, they typically assume uniform token contributions, making them less robust under short sequences or localized token modifications. To address these limitations, we propose Exons-Detect, a training-free method for AI-generated text detection based on an exon-aware token reweighting perspective. Exons-Detect identifies and amplifies informative exonic tokens by measuring hidden-state discrepancy under a dual-model setting, and computes an interpretable translation score from the resulting importance-weighted token sequence. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that Exons-Detect achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and exhibits strong robustness to adversarial attacks and varying input lengths. In particular, it attains a 2.2\% relative improvement in average AUROC over the strongest prior baseline on DetectRL.

AI.tldr: Exons-Detect：一种基于外显子感知令牌重加权的免训练AI文本检测方法，通过识别和放大信息丰富的外显子令牌，在对抗攻击和不同输入长度下表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的快速发展模糊了人类写作与AI生成文本的界限，带来了错误信息传播、作者身份模糊和知识产权威胁等社会风险，迫切需要有效可靠的检测方法。现有免训练方法通常通过聚合令牌级信号获得全局分数，但假设令牌贡献均匀，在短序列或局部令牌修改下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出Exons-Detect方法，基于外显子感知令牌重加权视角。通过双模型设置下测量隐藏状态差异来识别和放大信息丰富的外显子令牌，从重要性加权的令牌序列计算可解释的翻译分数。
AI.result: 实证评估显示Exons-Detect实现了最先进的检测性能，对对抗攻击和不同输入长度表现出强大的鲁棒性。在DetectRL数据集上，相对于先前最强基线实现了2.2%的平均AUROC相对提升。
AI.conclusion: Exons-Detect作为一种免训练的AI生成文本检测方法，通过外显子感知令牌重加权有效解决了现有方法的局限性，在检测性能和鲁棒性方面均表现出色，为应对AI生成文本带来的社会风险提供了可靠解决方案。

title: Confidence-Based Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussians
summary: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) greatly accelerated mesh extraction from posed images due to its explicit representation and fast software rasterization. While the addition of geometric losses and other priors has improved the accuracy of extracted surfaces, mesh extraction remains difficult in scenes with abundant view-dependent effects. To resolve the resulting ambiguities, prior works rely on multi-view techniques, iterative mesh extraction, or large pre-trained models, sacrificing the inherent efficiency of 3DGS. In this work, we present a simple and efficient alternative by introducing a self-supervised confidence framework to 3DGS: within this framework, learnable confidence values dynamically balance photometric and geometric supervision. Extending our confidence-driven formulation, we introduce losses which penalize per-primitive color and normal variance and demonstrate their benefits to surface extraction. Finally, we complement the above with an improved appearance model, by decoupling the individual terms of the D-SSIM loss. Our final approach delivers state-of-the-art results for unbounded meshes while remaining highly efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的自监督置信度框架，通过动态平衡光度与几何监督，结合改进的外观模型，实现了高效的无界网格提取。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅技术虽然加速了从姿态图像中提取网格的过程，但在具有丰富视角依赖效应的场景中，网格提取仍然困难。现有方法依赖多视角技术、迭代网格提取或大型预训练模型，牺牲了3DGS固有的效率。
AI.method: 1. 引入自监督置信度框架，可学习的置信度值动态平衡光度与几何监督；2. 扩展置信度驱动公式，引入惩罚每个基元颜色和法线方差的损失函数；3. 改进外观模型，解耦D-SSIM损失的各个项。
AI.result: 该方法在无界网格提取方面取得了最先进的结果，同时保持了高效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督置信度框架和改进的外观模型，本文提出了一种简单高效的替代方案，解决了3DGS在视角依赖效应丰富场景中的网格提取难题，实现了高效且高质量的网格重建。

title: A Framework for Generating Semantically Ambiguous Images to Probe Human and Machine Perception
summary: The classic duck-rabbit illusion reveals that when visual evidence is ambiguous, the human brain must decide what it sees. But where exactly do human observers draw the line between ''duck'' and ''rabbit'', and do machine classifiers draw it in the same place? We use semantically ambiguous images as interpretability probes to expose how vision models represent the boundaries between concepts. We present a psychophysically-informed framework that interpolates between concepts in the CLIP embedding space to generate continuous spectra of ambiguous images, allowing us to precisely measure where and how humans and machine classifiers place their semantic boundaries. Using this framework, we show that machine classifiers are more biased towards seeing ''rabbit'', whereas humans are more aligned with the CLIP embedding used for synthesis, and the guidance scale seems to affect human sensitivity more strongly than machine classifiers. Our framework demonstrates how controlled ambiguity can serve as a diagnostic tool to bridge the gap between human psychophysical analysis, image classification, and generative image models, offering insight into human-model alignment, robustness, model interpretability, and image synthesis methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用语义模糊图像作为可解释性探针，通过心理物理学框架在CLIP嵌入空间中插值生成连续模糊图像谱，比较人类和机器学习分类器在概念边界上的差异，发现机器分类器更偏向"兔子"而人类更接近CLIP嵌入。
AI.motivation: 经典的鸭兔错觉表明，当视觉证据模糊时，人类大脑必须决定看到什么。研究者希望探究人类和机器分类器在何处以及如何划定概念边界，使用语义模糊图像作为可解释性探针来揭示视觉模型如何表示概念之间的边界。
AI.method: 提出心理物理学框架，在CLIP嵌入空间中对概念进行插值，生成连续的模糊图像谱。通过这种方法精确测量人类和机器分类器放置语义边界的位置和方式，比较两者在概念边界判断上的差异。
AI.result: 研究发现机器分类器更偏向于看到"兔子"，而人类判断更接近用于图像合成的CLIP嵌入。引导尺度对人类敏感性的影响比对机器分类器更强。机器与人类在概念边界判断上存在系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 受控的模糊性可以作为诊断工具，弥合人类心理物理学分析、图像分类和生成图像模型之间的差距。该框架为人类-模型对齐、鲁棒性、模型可解释性和图像合成方法提供了新的见解。

title: Design Once, Deploy at Scale: Template-Driven ML Development for Large Model Ecosystems
summary:
Modern computational advertising platforms typically rely on recommendation systems to predict user responses, such as click-through rates, conversion rates, and other optimization events. To support a wide variety of product surfaces and advertiser goals, these platforms frequently maintain an extensive ecosystem of machine learning (ML) models. However, operating at this scale creates significant development and efficiency challenges. Substantial engineering effort is required to regularly refresh ML models and propagate new techniques, which results in long latencies when deploying ML innovations across the ecosystem.
  We present a large-scale empirical study comparing model performance, efficiency, and ML technique propagation between a standardized model-building approach and independent per-model optimization in recommendation systems. To facilitate this standardization, we propose the Standard Model Template (SMT) -- a framework that generates high-performance models adaptable to diverse data distributions and optimization events. By utilizing standardized, composable ML model components, SMT reduces technique propagation complexity from $O(n \cdot 2^k)$ to $O(n + k)$ where $n$ is the number of models and $k$ the number of techniques.
  Evaluating an extensive suite of models over four global development cycles within Meta's production ads ranking ecosystem, our results demonstrate: (1) a 0.63% average improvement in cross-entropy at neutral serving capacity, (2) a 92% reduction in per-model iteration engineering time, and (3) a $6.3\times$ increase in technique-model pair adoption throughput. These findings challenge the conventional wisdom that diverse optimization goals inherently require diversified ML model design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出标准模型模板(SMT)框架，通过标准化可组合的ML组件解决大规模广告推荐系统中模型开发和效率挑战，显著减少技术传播复杂度并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现代计算广告平台依赖推荐系统预测用户响应，但维护大量ML模型生态系统面临重大开发和效率挑战。工程团队需要定期刷新模型并传播新技术，导致跨生态系统部署ML创新的延迟较长。
AI.method: 提出标准模型模板(SMT)框架，生成适应不同数据分布和优化事件的高性能模型。利用标准化、可组合的ML模型组件，将技术传播复杂度从O(n·2^k)降低到O(n+k)。
AI.result: 在Meta广告排名生态系统的四个全球开发周期中评估：1) 在保持服务能力不变情况下，交叉熵平均改善0.63%；2) 每个模型迭代工程时间减少92%；3) 技术-模型对采用吞吐量提升6.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 标准化模型构建方法在推荐系统中表现优于独立优化方法，挑战了多样化优化目标需要多样化ML模型设计的传统观念。SMT框架能显著提升效率并加速技术创新传播。

title: Approaches to Analysing Historical Newspapers Using LLMs
summary: This study presents a computational analysis of the Slovene historical newspapers \textit{Slovenec} and \textit{Slovenski narod} from the sPeriodika corpus, combining topic modelling, large language model (LLM)-based aspect-level sentiment analysis, entity-graph visualisation, and qualitative discourse analysis to examine how collective identities, political orientations, and national belonging were represented in public discourse at the turn of the twentieth century. Using BERTopic, we identify major thematic patterns and show both shared concerns and clear ideological differences between the two newspapers, reflecting their conservative-Catholic and liberal-progressive orientations. We further evaluate four instruction-following LLMs for targeted sentiment classification in OCR-degraded historical Slovene and select the Slovene-adapted GaMS3-12B-Instruct model as the most suitable for large-scale application, while also documenting important limitations, particularly its stronger performance on neutral sentiment than on positive or negative sentiment. Applied at dataset scale, the model reveals meaningful variation in the portrayal of collective identities, with some groups appearing predominantly in neutral descriptive contexts and others more often in evaluative or conflict-related discourse. We then create NER graphs to explore the relationships between collective identities and places. We apply a mixed methods approach to analyse the named entity graphs, combining quantitative network analysis with critical discourse analysis. The investigation focuses on the emergence and development of intertwined historical political and socionomic identities. Overall, the study demonstrates the value of combining scalable computational methods with critical interpretation to support digital humanities research on noisy historical newspaper data.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合主题建模、基于LLM的细粒度情感分析、实体图可视化和质性话语分析，对斯洛文尼亚历史报纸《Slovenec》和《Slovenski narod》进行多方法计算分析，探究20世纪初集体身份、政治取向和国家归属的公共话语表征。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过计算人文方法，分析斯洛文尼亚历史报纸中集体身份、政治取向和国家归属的公共话语表征，探索如何结合可扩展的计算方法与批判性解释来支持数字人文研究。
AI.method: 采用多方法混合研究设计：1) 使用BERTopic进行主题建模识别主要主题模式；2) 评估四种指令遵循LLM进行OCR降质历史斯洛文尼亚语的情感分类，选择Slovene-adapted GaMS3-12B-Instruct模型；3) 创建NER图探索集体身份与地点关系；4) 结合定量网络分析与批判性话语分析。
AI.result: 1) 主题建模显示两报既有共同关注点又有明显意识形态差异，反映其保守-天主教和自由-进步取向；2) GaMS3-12B-Instruct模型在历史斯洛文尼亚语情感分类中表现最佳，但对中性情感识别优于积极/消极情感；3) 大规模应用揭示集体身份表征存在有意义差异，有些群体主要出现在中性描述语境，有些更多出现在评价性或冲突相关话语中；4) 实体图分析揭示了交织的历史政治和社会经济身份。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了结合可扩展计算方法与批判性解释在分析嘈杂历史报纸数据中的价值，为数字人文研究提供了有效的方法论框架，同时揭示了历史话语中集体身份建构的复杂性。

title: The Anatomy of Uncertainty in LLMs
summary: Understanding why a large language model (LLM) is uncertain about the response is important for their reliable deployment. Current approaches, which either provide a single uncertainty score or rely on the classical aleatoric-epistemic dichotomy, fail to offer actionable insights for improving the generative model. Recent studies have also shown that such methods are not enough for understanding uncertainty in LLMs. In this work, we advocate for an uncertainty decomposition framework that dissects LLM uncertainty into three distinct semantic components: (i) input ambiguity, arising from ambiguous prompts; (ii) knowledge gaps, caused by insufficient parametric evidence; and (iii) decoding randomness, stemming from stochastic sampling. Through a series of experiments we demonstrate that the dominance of these components can shift across model size and task. Our framework provides a better understanding to audit LLM reliability and detect hallucinations, paving the way for targeted interventions and more trustworthy systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的LLM不确定性分解框架，将不确定性分为三个语义组件：输入歧义、知识缺口和解码随机性，以更好地理解和改进LLM的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM不确定性评估方法存在局限性：要么只提供单一不确定性分数，要么依赖经典的概率-认知二分法，这些方法无法为改进生成模型提供可操作的见解。现有研究表明这些方法不足以理解LLM的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出一个不确定性分解框架，将LLM不确定性分解为三个语义组件：1) 输入歧义（由模糊提示引起）；2) 知识缺口（由参数证据不足导致）；3) 解码随机性（源于随机采样）。通过一系列实验验证该框架的有效性。
AI.result: 实验表明这些不确定性组件在不同模型规模和任务中的主导地位会发生变化。该框架为审计LLM可靠性和检测幻觉提供了更好的理解，有助于实现更有针对性的干预和更可信的系统。
AI.conclusion: 提出的三组件不确定性分解框架比现有方法更能提供可操作的见解，有助于理解LLM不确定性来源，为改进模型可靠性和检测幻觉提供了新途径。

title: Closing the Confidence-Faithfulness Gap in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) tend to verbalize confidence scores that are largely detached from their actual accuracy, yet the geometric relationship governing this behavior remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a mechanistic interpretability analysis of verbalized confidence, using linear probes and contrastive activation addition (CAA) steering to show that calibration and verbalized confidence signals are encoded linearly but are orthogonal to one another -- a finding consistent across three open-weight models and four datasets. Interestingly, when models are prompted to simultaneously reason through a problem and verbalize a confidence score, the reasoning process disrupts the verbalized confidence direction, exacerbating miscalibration. We term this the "Reasoning Contamination Effect." Leveraging this insight, we introduce a two-stage adaptive steering pipeline that reads the model's internal accuracy estimate and steers verbalized output to match it, substantially improving calibration alignment across all evaluated models.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型的置信度表达与其实际准确性脱节，两者在线性表示中正交，推理过程会污染置信度表达，提出自适应引导方法改善校准
AI.motivation: 大语言模型倾向于表达与实际准确性脱节的置信度分数，但控制这种行为的几何关系仍不清楚，需要理解其内部机制
AI.method: 使用线性探针和对比激活加法引导技术分析三个开源模型和四个数据集，发现校准信号和置信度表达信号线性编码但正交，提出两阶段自适应引导管道
AI.result: 发现推理过程会污染置信度表达方向，加剧校准错误（称为"推理污染效应"），自适应引导方法显著改善了所有评估模型的校准对齐
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的置信度表达和校准信号在线性表示中正交，推理过程会干扰置信度表达，通过读取内部准确性估计并引导输出匹配，可以有效改善校准

title: TIGeR: A Unified Framework for Time, Images and Geo-location Retrieval
summary: Many real-world applications in digital forensics, urban monitoring, and environmental analysis require jointly reasoning about visual appearance, geolocation, and time. Beyond standard geo-localization and time-of-capture prediction, these applications increasingly demand more complex capabilities, such as retrieving an image captured at the same location as a query image but at a specified target time. We formalize this problem as Geo-Time Aware Image Retrieval and curate a diverse benchmark of 4.5M paired image-location-time triplets for training and 86k high-quality triplets for evaluation. We then propose TIGeR, a multi-modal-transformer-based model that maps image, geolocation, and time into a unified geo-temporal embedding space. TIGeR supports flexible input configurations (single-modality and multi-modality queries) and uses the same representation to perform (i) geo-localization, (ii) time-of-capture prediction, and (iii) geo-time-aware retrieval. By better preserving underlying location identity under large appearance changes, TIGeR enables retrieval based on where and when a scene is, rather than purely on visual similarity. Extensive experiments show that TIGeR consistently outperforms strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods by up to 16% on time-of-year, 8% time-of-day prediction, and 14% in geo-time aware retrieval recall, highlighting the benefits of unified geo-temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: TIGeR：一个多模态transformer模型，将图像、地理位置和时间映射到统一的时空嵌入空间，支持灵活输入配置，在时空感知图像检索任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 数字取证、城市监控和环境分析等实际应用需要联合推理视觉外观、地理位置和时间。现有方法主要关注标准的地理定位和时间预测，但实际应用需要更复杂的能力，如检索在查询图像相同位置但在指定目标时间拍摄的图像。
AI.method: 提出TIGeR模型，基于多模态transformer架构，将图像、地理位置和时间映射到统一的时空嵌入空间。支持灵活输入配置（单模态和多模态查询），使用相同表示执行地理定位、拍摄时间预测和时空感知检索。
AI.result: 在包含450万训练对和8.6万高质量评估对的基准测试中，TIGeR显著优于强基线方法和最先进方法：时间预测（年份）提升16%，时间预测（天）提升8%，时空感知检索召回率提升14%。
AI.conclusion: 通过更好地在视觉外观大幅变化下保持底层位置身份，TIGeR能够基于场景的时空位置而非纯粹视觉相似性进行检索，统一的时空建模方法在实际应用中具有显著优势。

title: Rethinking Failure Attribution in Multi-Agent Systems: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark and Evaluation
summary: Failure attribution is essential for diagnosing and improving multi-agent systems (MAS), yet existing benchmarks and methods largely assume a single deterministic root cause for each failure. In practice, MAS failures often admit multiple plausible attributions due to complex inter-agent dependencies and ambiguous execution trajectories. We revisit MAS failure attribution from a multi-perspective standpoint and propose multi-perspective failure attribution, a practical paradigm that explicitly accounts for attribution ambiguity. To support this setting, we introduce MP-Bench, the first benchmark designed for multi-perspective failure attribution in MAS, along with a new evaluation protocol tailored to this paradigm. Through extensive experiments, we find that prior conclusions suggesting LLMs struggle with failure attribution are largely driven by limitations in existing benchmark designs. Our results highlight the necessity of multi-perspective benchmarks and evaluation protocols for realistic and reliable MAS debugging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视角故障归因范式，针对多智能体系统故障归因的模糊性问题，建立了首个多视角故障归因基准MP-Bench和相应评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统故障归因研究通常假设每个故障只有一个确定性根本原因，但实践中由于复杂的智能体间依赖关系和模糊的执行轨迹，故障往往存在多个合理的归因视角。
AI.method: 提出多视角故障归因范式，明确考虑归因模糊性；开发MP-Bench基准数据集，包含多视角故障归因场景；设计专门针对该范式的新评估协议。
AI.result: 实验表明，先前关于LLM在故障归因方面表现不佳的结论主要源于现有基准设计的局限性。多视角基准和评估协议对于实现现实可靠的多智能体系统调试至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多视角故障归因是更实用的范式，MP-Bench基准和相应评估协议能够更真实地反映多智能体系统故障归因的复杂性，为可靠的系统调试提供必要支持。

title: A Public Theory of Distillation Resistance via Constraint-Coupled Reasoning Architectures
summary: Knowledge distillation, model extraction, and behavior transfer have become central concerns in frontier AI. The main risk is not merely copying, but the possibility that useful capability can be transferred more cheaply than the governance structure that originally accompanied it. This paper presents a public, trade-secret-safe theoretical framework for reducing that asymmetry at the architectural level. The core claim is that distillation becomes less valuable as a shortcut when high-level capability is coupled to internal stability constraints that shape state transitions over time. To formalize this idea, the paper introduces a constraint-coupled reasoning framework with four elements: bounded transition burden, path-load accumulation, dynamically evolving feasible regions, and a capability-stability coupling condition. The paper is intentionally public-safe: it omits proprietary implementation details, training recipes, thresholds, hidden-state instrumentation, deployment procedures, and confidential system design choices. The contribution is therefore theoretical rather than operational. It offers a falsifiable architectural thesis, a clear threat model, and a set of experimentally testable hypotheses for future work on distillation resistance, alignment, and model governance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种理论框架，通过将高级能力与内部稳定性约束耦合，降低知识蒸馏的价值，从而减少能力转移与治理结构之间的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI领域面临知识蒸馏、模型提取和行为转移带来的风险，主要问题不是简单的复制，而是有用能力可能比伴随的治理结构更便宜地被转移，导致治理不对称。
AI.method: 提出了一个约束耦合推理框架，包含四个要素：有界转移负担、路径负载累积、动态演化可行区域以及能力-稳定性耦合条件。该框架是公开安全的，省略了专有实现细节。
AI.result: 提供了一个可证伪的架构论点、清晰的威胁模型以及一组可实验验证的假设，为蒸馏抵抗、对齐和模型治理的未来研究奠定理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高级能力与内部稳定性约束耦合，可以在架构层面减少蒸馏作为捷径的价值，从而降低能力转移与治理结构之间的不对称性，为AI治理提供理论支持。

title: Do LLMs Know What They Know? Measuring Metacognitive Efficiency with Signal Detection Theory
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Pre-registered; code and data at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sdt_calibration
summary: Standard evaluation of LLM confidence relies on calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score) that conflate two distinct capacities: how much a model knows (Type-1 sensitivity) and how well it knows what it knows (Type-2 metacognitive sensitivity). We introduce an evaluation framework based on Type-2 Signal Detection Theory that decomposes these capacities using meta-d' and the metacognitive efficiency ratio M-ratio. Applied to four LLMs (Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Llama-3-8B-Base, Gemma-2-9B-Instruct) across 224,000 factual QA trials, we find: (1) metacognitive efficiency varies substantially across models even when Type-1 sensitivity is similar -- Mistral achieves the highest d' but the lowest M-ratio; (2) metacognitive efficiency is domain-specific, with different models showing different weakest domains, invisible to aggregate metrics; (3) temperature manipulation shifts Type-2 criterion while meta-d' remains stable for two of four models, dissociating confidence policy from metacognitive capacity; (4) AUROC_2 and M-ratio produce fully inverted model rankings, demonstrating these metrics answer fundamentally different evaluation questions. The meta-d' framework reveals which models "know what they don't know" versus which merely appear well-calibrated due to criterion placement -- a distinction with direct implications for model selection, deployment, and human-AI collaboration. Pre-registered analysis; code and data publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Type-2信号检测理论的评估框架，将LLM的置信度评估分解为知识能力（Type-1敏感性）和元认知能力（Type-2元认知敏感性），使用meta-d'和M-ratio指标，发现元认知效率在不同模型间差异显著且具有领域特异性。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM置信度评估使用校准指标（如ECE、Brier分数）混淆了两种不同能力：模型知道多少（Type-1敏感性）和模型知道自己知道什么（Type-2元认知敏感性）。需要新的评估框架来区分这两种能力，以更准确地评估模型是否"知道自己不知道什么"。
AI.method: 引入基于Type-2信号检测理论的评估框架，使用meta-d'和元认知效率比M-ratio指标。在四个LLM模型（Llama-3-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Llama-3-8B-Base、Gemma-2-9B-Instruct）上进行评估，涵盖224,000个事实问答试验。分析包括：1）元认知效率的模型间差异；2）领域特异性分析；3）温度参数对Type-2标准的影响；4）不同评估指标的对比。
AI.result: 1）元认知效率在不同模型间差异显著，即使Type-1敏感性相似——Mistral获得最高的d'但最低的M-ratio；2）元认知效率具有领域特异性，不同模型在不同领域表现最弱，这在聚合指标中不可见；3）温度参数改变Type-2标准，而meta-d'在两个模型中保持稳定，表明置信度策略与元认知能力可分离；4）AUROC_2和M-ratio产生完全相反的模型排名，显示这些指标回答根本不同的评估问题。
AI.conclusion: meta-d'框架揭示了哪些模型真正"知道自己不知道什么"，哪些仅仅因为标准设置而显得校准良好。这一区分对模型选择、部署和人机协作具有直接意义。研究采用预注册分析，代码和数据公开可用。

title: DRoPS: Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Pre-Scanned Objects
summary: Dynamic scene reconstruction from casual videos has seen recent remarkable progress. Numerous approaches have attempted to overcome the ill-posedness of the task by distilling priors from 2D foundational models and by imposing hand-crafted regularization on the optimized motion. However, these methods struggle to reconstruct scenes from extreme novel viewpoints, especially when highly articulated motions are present. In this paper, we present DRoPS, a novel approach that leverages a static pre-scan of the dynamic object as an explicit geometric and appearance prior. While existing state-of-the-art methods fail to fully exploit the pre-scan, DRoPS leverages our novel setup to effectively constrain the solution space and ensure geometrical consistency throughout the sequence. The core of our novelty is twofold: first, we establish a grid-structured and surface-aligned model by organizing Gaussian primitives into pixel grids anchored to the object surface. Second, by leveraging the grid structure of our primitives, we parameterize motion using a CNN conditioned on those grids, injecting strong implicit regularization and correlating the motion of nearby points. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms the current state of the art in rendering quality and 3D tracking accuracy.

AI.tldr: DRoPS是一种利用静态预扫描作为几何和外观先验的动态场景重建新方法，通过将高斯基元组织成物体表面锚定的像素网格，并使用CNN参数化运动，显著提升了极端新视角下的渲染质量和3D跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过从2D基础模型提取先验和手工运动正则化来应对动态场景重建的欠定性问题，但在存在高度关节运动时，难以从极端新视角重建场景。需要更有效利用静态预扫描信息来约束解空间并确保几何一致性。
AI.method: 1) 建立网格结构和表面对齐模型：将高斯基元组织成锚定在物体表面的像素网格；2) 利用基元的网格结构，使用CNN参数化运动，该CNN以这些网格为条件，注入强隐式正则化并关联邻近点的运动。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，该方法在渲染质量和3D跟踪精度方面显著优于当前最先进方法，特别是在处理高度关节运动和极端新视角时表现优异。
AI.conclusion: DRoPS通过有效利用静态预扫描作为几何先验，结合网格结构的高斯基元组织和CNN运动参数化，成功解决了动态场景重建中的几何一致性问题，为从极端新视角重建具有高度关节运动的场景提供了有效解决方案。

title: System-Anchored Knee Estimation for Low-Cost Context Window Selection in PDE Forecasting
summary: Autoregressive neural PDE simulators predict the evolution of physical fields one step at a time from a finite history, but low-cost context-window selection for such simulators remains an unformalized problem. Existing approaches to context-window selection in time-series forecasting include exhaustive validation, direct low-cost search, and system-theoretic memory estimation, but they are either expensive, brittle, or not directly aligned with downstream rollout performance. We formalize explicit context-window selection for fixed-window autoregressive neural PDE simulators as an independent low-cost algorithmic problem, and propose \textbf{System-Anchored Knee Estimation (SAKE)}, a two-stage method that first identifies a small structured candidate set from physically interpretable system anchors and then performs knee-aware downstream selection within it. Across all eight PDEBench families evaluated under the shared \(L\in\{1,\dots,16\}\) protocol, SAKE is the strongest overall matched-budget low-cost selector among the evaluated methods, achieving 67.8\% Exact, 91.7\% Within-1, 6.1\% mean regret@knee, and a cost ratio of 0.051 (94.9\% normalized search-cost savings).

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAKE方法，用于解决自回归神经PDE模拟器中低成本上下文窗口选择的问题，通过系统锚定和膝点感知选择，在PDEBench上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归神经PDE模拟器需要从有限历史中预测物理场演化，但低成本上下文窗口选择问题尚未被形式化。现有方法要么昂贵、脆弱，要么与下游滚动性能不直接对齐。
AI.method: 提出系统锚定膝点估计（SAKE）方法：第一阶段从物理可解释的系统锚点识别小型结构化候选集；第二阶段在候选集中进行膝点感知的下游选择。
AI.result: 在PDEBench的8个家族评估中，SAKE是最强的匹配预算低成本选择器，达到67.8%精确匹配率、91.7%在1步内、6.1%平均遗憾@膝点，成本比仅为0.051（节省94.9%搜索成本）。
AI.conclusion: SAKE成功形式化了自回归神经PDE模拟器的显式上下文窗口选择问题，提供了一种物理可解释、低成本且性能优异的解决方案。

title: AVControl: Efficient Framework for Training Audio-Visual Controls
summary: Controlling video and audio generation requires diverse modalities, from depth and pose to camera trajectories and audio transformations, yet existing approaches either train a single monolithic model for a fixed set of controls or introduce costly architectural changes for each new modality. We introduce AVControl, a lightweight, extendable framework built on LTX-2, a joint audio-visual foundation model, where each control modality is trained as a separate LoRA on a parallel canvas that provides the reference signal as additional tokens in the attention layers, requiring no architectural changes beyond the LoRA adapters themselves.
