We show that simply extending image-based in-context methods to video fails for structural control, and that our parallel canvas approach resolves this. On the VACE Benchmark, we outperform all evaluated baselines on depth- and pose-guided generation, inpainting, and outpainting, and show competitive results on camera control and audio-visual benchmarks. Our framework supports a diverse set of independently trained modalities: spatially-aligned controls such as depth, pose, and edges, camera trajectory with intrinsics, sparse motion control, video editing, and, to our knowledge, the first modular audio-visual controls for a joint generation model. Our method is both compute- and data-efficient: each modality requires only a small dataset and converges within a few hundred to a few thousand training steps, a fraction of the budget of monolithic alternatives. We publicly release our code and trained LoRA checkpoints.

AI.tldr: AVControl是一个轻量级、可扩展的视频音频生成控制框架，基于LTX-2联合视听基础模型，通过LoRA适配器实现多种模态控制，无需架构修改
AI.motivation: 现有视频音频生成控制方法要么训练单一固定控制集的庞大模型，要么为每个新模态引入昂贵的架构修改，缺乏灵活高效的解决方案
AI.method: 基于LTX-2联合视听基础模型，每个控制模态作为独立的LoRA适配器训练，在并行画布上提供参考信号作为注意力层的额外token，仅需LoRA适配器无需架构修改
AI.result: 在VACE基准测试中，在深度和姿态引导生成、修复、外绘方面优于所有基线，在相机控制和视听基准测试中表现竞争性；支持多种独立训练的模态控制
AI.conclusion: AVControl提供了一种计算和数据高效的框架，每个模态仅需小数据集和少量训练步骤，支持多样化控制模态，是首个模块化视听控制的联合生成模型方法

title: To Write or to Automate Linguistic Prompts, That Is the Question
comment: 10 pages, to be submitted for EAMT 2026
summary: LLM performance is highly sensitive to prompt design, yet whether automatic prompt optimization can replace expert prompt engineering in linguistic tasks remains unexplored. We present the first systematic comparison of hand-crafted zero-shot expert prompts, base DSPy signatures, and GEPA-optimized DSPy signatures across translation, terminology insertion, and language quality assessment, evaluating five model configurations. Results are task-dependent. In terminology insertion, optimized and manual prompts produce mostly statistically indistinguishable quality. In translation, each approach wins on different models. In LQA, expert prompts achieve stronger error detection while optimization improves characterization. Across all tasks, GEPA elevates minimal DSPy signatures, and the majority of expert-optimized comparisons show no statistically significant difference. We note that the comparison is asymmetric: GEPA optimization searches programmatically over gold-standard splits, whereas expert prompts require in principle no labeled data, relying instead on domain expertise and iterative refinement.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统比较了手工设计的零样本专家提示、基础DSPy签名和GEPA优化的DSPy签名在翻译、术语插入和语言质量评估任务中的表现，发现结果具有任务依赖性，多数情况下优化提示与专家提示在统计上无显著差异。
AI.motivation: LLM性能对提示设计高度敏感，但自动提示优化是否能替代专家提示工程在语言任务中的应用尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白，系统比较不同提示设计方法的效果。
AI.method: 在翻译、术语插入和语言质量评估三个语言任务中，比较了三种方法：1) 手工设计的零样本专家提示；2) 基础DSPy签名；3) GEPA优化的DSPy签名。评估了五种模型配置，使用统计方法分析结果差异。
AI.result: 结果具有任务依赖性：在术语插入任务中，优化提示和手工提示质量基本无统计差异；在翻译任务中，不同方法在不同模型上表现最佳；在语言质量评估中，专家提示在错误检测方面更强，而优化提示在特征描述方面更好。总体而言，GEPA显著提升了基础DSPy签名的性能，大多数专家提示与优化提示的比较在统计上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 自动提示优化在某些任务中能够达到与专家提示相当的效果，但比较存在不对称性：GEPA优化需要程序化搜索黄金标准数据，而专家提示原则上不需要标注数据，依赖领域专业知识和迭代优化。这表明两种方法各有优势，应根据具体任务需求选择合适的方法。

title: Calibri: Enhancing Diffusion Transformers via Parameter-Efficient Calibration
comment: Accepted to CVRP 2026, Project page: https://v-gen-ai.github.io/Calibri-page/
summary: In this paper, we uncover the hidden potential of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) to significantly enhance generative tasks. Through an in-depth analysis of the denoising process, we demonstrate that introducing a single learned scaling parameter can significantly improve the performance of DiT blocks. Building on this insight, we propose Calibri, a parameter-efficient approach that optimally calibrates DiT components to elevate generative quality. Calibri frames DiT calibration as a black-box reward optimization problem, which is efficiently solved using an evolutionary algorithm and modifies just ~100 parameters. Experimental results reveal that despite its lightweight design, Calibri consistently improves performance across various text-to-image models. Notably, Calibri also reduces the inference steps required for image generation, all while maintaining high-quality outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Calibri方法，通过引入单个学习缩放参数和进化算法优化DiT组件，仅修改约100个参数即可显著提升扩散变换器的生成性能并减少推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 研究发现扩散变换器（DiTs）在去噪过程中存在未被充分利用的潜力，通过引入简单的缩放参数可以显著提升DiT块的性能，从而改善生成任务的质量。
AI.method: 提出Calibri方法：1）引入单个学习缩放参数优化DiT块；2）将DiT校准建模为黑盒奖励优化问题；3）使用进化算法高效求解，仅修改约100个参数。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Calibri在各种文本到图像模型中都能持续提升性能，同时还能减少图像生成所需的推理步骤，同时保持高质量输出。
AI.conclusion: Calibri是一种参数高效的方法，通过优化DiT组件的校准，能够显著提升扩散变换器的生成质量，同时减少计算成本，为生成模型优化提供了新思路。

title: Mechanistically Interpreting Compression in Vision-Language Models
summary: Compressed vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used to reduce memory and compute costs, making them a suitable choice for real-world deployment. However, compressing these models raises concerns about whether internal computations and safety behaviors are preserved. In this work, we use causal circuit analysis and crosscoder-based feature comparisons to examine how pruning and quantization fundamentally change the internals across representative VLMs. We observe that pruning generally keeps circuit structure intact but rotates and attenuates internal features, while quantization modifies the circuits at a higher level yet leaves the surviving features better aligned. Leveraging this insight, we also introduce VLMSafe-420, a novel benchmark that pairs harmful inputs with matched benign counterfactuals across various safety categories. Our findings show that pruning causes a sharp drop in genuine refusal behavior, suggesting that the choice of compression has safety implications.

AI.tldr: 压缩视觉语言模型会改变内部计算和安全行为，剪枝保持电路结构但旋转衰减特征，量化修改高级电路但特征对齐更好，剪枝导致拒绝行为显著下降
AI.motivation: 压缩视觉语言模型虽然能降低内存和计算成本，但压缩过程是否保持内部计算和安全行为存在担忧，需要研究压缩如何改变模型内部机制
AI.method: 使用因果电路分析和跨编码器特征比较，检查剪枝和量化如何改变代表性视觉语言模型的内部机制，并引入VLMSafe-420基准测试
AI.result: 剪枝通常保持电路结构完整但旋转和衰减内部特征，量化修改高级电路但保留的特征对齐更好；剪枝导致真实拒绝行为急剧下降
AI.conclusion: 压缩方法的选择对模型安全性有重要影响，剪枝会显著损害安全拒绝行为，需要谨慎选择压缩策略以确保模型安全性

title: Prompt Attack Detection with LLM-as-a-Judge and Mixture-of-Models
summary: Prompt attacks, including jailbreaks and prompt injections, pose a critical security risk to Large Language Model (LLM) systems. In production, guardrails must mitigate these attacks under strict low-latency constraints, resulting in a deployment gap in which lightweight classifiers and rule-based systems struggle to generalize under distribution shift, while high-capacity LLM-based judges remain too slow or costly for live enforcement. In this work, we examine whether lightweight, general-purpose LLMs can reliably serve as security judges under real-world production constraints. Through careful prompt and output design, lightweight LLMs are guided through a structured reasoning process involving explicit intent decomposition, safety-signal verification, harm assessment, and self-reflection. We evaluate our method on a curated dataset combining benign queries from real-world chatbots with adversarial prompts generated via automated red teaming (ART), covering diverse and evolving patterns. Our results show that general-purpose LLMs, such as gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001, can serve as effective low-latency judges for live guardrails. This configuration is currently deployed in production as a centralized guardrail service for public service chatbots in Singapore. We additionally evaluate a Mixture-of-Models (MoM) setting to assess whether aggregating multiple LLM judges improves prompt-attack detection performance relative to single-model judges, with only modest gains observed.

AI.tldr: 轻量级LLM通过结构化推理流程可作为实时防护栏的安全裁判，在新加坡公共服务聊天机器人中已部署应用。
AI.motivation: 现有防护栏系统存在部署差距：轻量级分类器和基于规则的系统难以应对分布偏移，而高容量LLM裁判又太慢或成本太高，无法满足实时执行的低延迟要求。
AI.method: 通过精心设计的提示和输出结构，引导轻量级LLM进行结构化推理，包括显式意图分解、安全信号验证、危害评估和自我反思。
AI.result: 评估显示，通用轻量级LLM（如gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001）可作为有效的低延迟裁判用于实时防护栏，已在新加坡公共服务聊天机器人中部署。多模型集成(MoM)设置仅带来适度性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级通用LLM通过结构化推理流程能够可靠地作为安全裁判，满足实际生产环境中的低延迟约束，为LLM系统提供有效的实时防护栏解决方案。

title: Cross-Preference Learning for Sentence-Level and Context-Aware Machine Translation
summary: Context-aware machine translation (MT) leverages document-level information, yet it does not consistently outperform sentence-level MT, as contextual signals are unevenly beneficial across sentences. Existing training objectives do not explicitly model this variability, limiting a model's ability to adaptively exploit context. In this paper, we propose Cross-Preference Learning (CPL), a preference-based training framework that explicitly captures the complementary benefits of sentence-level and context-aware MT. CPL achieves this by integrating both intra- and cross-condition preferences into the preference optimization objective. The introduction of intra- and cross-condition preferences provides explicit supervision on when and how contextual information improves translation quality. We validate the proposed approach on several public context-aware MT tasks using multiple models, including Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3-8B. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in translation quality and robustness across both input conditions, achieved without any architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于偏好的训练框架CPL，通过整合句子级和上下文感知机器翻译的互补优势，解决了现有上下文感知MT性能不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: 上下文感知机器翻译虽然利用文档级信息，但性能并不总是优于句子级翻译，因为上下文信号在不同句子中的益处不均匀。现有训练目标没有明确建模这种变异性，限制了模型自适应利用上下文的能力。
AI.method: 提出了Cross-Preference Learning (CPL)框架，通过将内部条件和跨条件偏好整合到偏好优化目标中，明确捕捉句子级和上下文感知MT的互补优势。该方法不需要任何架构修改。
AI.result: 在多个公共上下文感知MT任务上使用Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3-8B等模型进行验证，实验结果显示翻译质量和鲁棒性在不同输入条件下都得到了一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CPL框架通过显式建模上下文信息的益处变异性，有效提升了上下文感知机器翻译的性能和鲁棒性，为自适应利用上下文信息提供了新思路。

title: GoldiCLIP: The Goldilocks Approach for Balancing Explicit Supervision for Language-Image Pretraining
summary: Until recently, the success of large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) has primarily relied on billion-sample datasets, posing a significant barrier to progress. Latest works have begun to close this gap by improving supervision quality, but each addresses only a subset of the weaknesses in contrastive pretraining. We present GoldiCLIP, a framework built on a Goldilocks principle of finding the right balance of supervision signals. Our multifaceted training framework synergistically combines three key innovations: (1) a text-conditioned self-distillation method to align both text-agnostic and text-conditioned features; (2) an encoder integrated decoder with Visual Question Answering (VQA) objective that enables the encoder to generalize beyond the caption-like queries; and (3) an uncertainty-based weighting mechanism that automatically balances all heterogeneous losses. Trained on just 30 million images, 300x less data than leading methods, GoldiCLIP achieves state-of-the-art among data-efficient approaches, improving over the best comparable baseline by 2.2 points on MSCOCO retrieval, 2.0 on fine-grained retrieval, and 5.9 on question-based retrieval, while remaining competitive with billion-scale models. Project page: https://petsi.uk/goldiclip.

AI.tldr: GoldiCLIP是一个基于"恰到好处"原则的视觉语言模型训练框架，仅用3000万图像（比主流方法少300倍）就实现了最先进的数据效率，在多种检索任务上显著超越基线模型。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)的成功通常依赖于数十亿样本的数据集，这成为研究进展的重大障碍。虽然近期工作通过提升监督质量来缩小差距，但每个方法只解决了对比预训练中的部分弱点，需要找到监督信号的恰当平衡。
AI.method: GoldiCLIP框架包含三个关键创新：(1)文本条件自蒸馏方法，对齐文本无关和文本条件特征；(2)集成解码器的编码器，通过视觉问答(VQA)目标使编码器超越标题式查询；(3)基于不确定性的加权机制，自动平衡所有异构损失。
AI.result: 仅用3000万图像训练（比领先方法少300倍），GoldiCLIP在数据高效方法中达到最先进水平：在MSCOCO检索上提升2.2分，细粒度检索提升2.0分，基于问题的检索提升5.9分，同时与数十亿规模模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GoldiCLIP通过找到监督信号的恰当平衡，显著降低了视觉语言模型训练的数据需求，仅用少量数据就能实现强大的性能，为数据高效的多模态学习提供了新方向。

title: Sparse Visual Thought Circuits in Vision-Language Models
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) improve interpretability in multimodal models, but it remains unclear whether SAE features form modular, composable units for reasoning-an assumption underlying many intervention-based steering methods. We test this modularity hypothesis and find it often fails: intervening on a task-selective feature set can modestly improve reasoning accuracy, while intervening on the union of two such sets reliably induces output drift (large unintended changes in predictions) and degrades accuracy, even under norm-matched perturbations. This non modular circuit interference is consistent with shared internal pathways where feature unions amplify activation shifts. We develop a reproducible causal pipeline to localize and test these sparse visual thought circuits in Qwen3-VL-8B. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with seven task types and three difficulty levels, linear probes identify a mid decoder locus for task type information. We train SAEs at this layer, construct task-selective sets via an explicit rule, and perform inference time scaling and ablation while quantifying accuracy and drift. Our findings-validated with bootstrapped subsamples and permutation controls, and replicated across multiple VLM families and five diverse datasets clarify the boundaries of SAE feature composability and provide a rigorous diagnostic framework for more reliable VLM control.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在视觉语言模型中并不总是形成模块化、可组合的推理单元，特征联合干预会导致输出漂移和准确率下降，揭示了SAE特征可组合性的局限性。
AI.motivation: 虽然稀疏自编码器（SAEs）能提升多模态模型的可解释性，但尚不清楚SAE特征是否真正形成模块化、可组合的推理单元——这是许多基于干预的引导方法的基本假设。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-8B模型中开发可复现的因果分析流程：1）在受控合成基准上使用线性探针定位任务类型信息的中层解码器位置；2）在该层训练SAEs；3）通过明确规则构建任务选择性特征集；4）进行推理时缩放和消融实验，同时量化准确率和输出漂移；5）使用自助子样本和排列控制进行验证，并在多个VLM家族和五个不同数据集上复现。
AI.result: 模块化假设经常失败：干预任务选择性特征集能适度提升推理准确率，但干预两个特征集的联合则可靠地导致输出漂移（预测的大幅意外变化）和准确率下降，即使是在范数匹配的扰动下。这种非模块化电路干扰与共享内部通路一致，其中特征联合会放大激活偏移。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了SAE特征可组合性的边界，为更可靠的VLM控制提供了严谨的诊断框架，揭示了基于SAE特征的干预方法需要更谨慎地考虑特征间的非模块化交互。

title: Probing the Lack of Stable Internal Beliefs in LLMs
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2025 Workshop Mexico City PersonaNLP
summary: Persona-driven large language models (LLMs) require consistent behavioral tendencies across interactions to simulate human-like personality traits, such as persistence or reliability. However, current LLMs often lack stable internal representations that anchor their responses over extended dialogues. This work explores whether LLMs can maintain "implicit consistency", defined as persistent adherence to an unstated goal in multi-turn interactions. We designed a 20-question-style riddle game paradigm where an LLM is tasked with secretly selecting a target and responding to users' guesses with "yes/no" answers. Through evaluations, we find that LLMs struggle to preserve latent consistency: their implicit "goals" shift across turns unless explicitly provided their selected target in context. These findings highlight critical limitations in the building of persona-driven LLMs and underscore the need for mechanisms that anchor implicit goals over time, which is a key to realistic personality modeling in interactive applications such as dialogue systems.

AI.tldr: LLMs在模拟人类个性时缺乏稳定的内在一致性，特别是在多轮对话中难以保持未明说的目标一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于角色的LLMs在模拟人类个性特质（如坚持性、可靠性）时，缺乏稳定的内部表征来锚定其长期对话中的行为倾向，这限制了构建真实人格模型的能力。
AI.method: 设计了一个20个问题式的谜语游戏范式，让LLM秘密选择一个目标，然后对用户的猜测回答"是/否"。通过评估LLM在多轮交互中是否能保持"隐含一致性"（即对未明说目标的持续坚持）。
AI.result: LLMs难以保持隐含一致性：除非在上下文中明确提供其选择的目标，否则它们的隐含"目标"会在多轮对话中发生偏移。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现突显了构建角色驱动LLMs的关键局限性，强调需要开发能够锚定隐含目标的机制，这对于交互式应用（如对话系统）中的真实人格建模至关重要。

title: Attention-based Pin Site Image Classification in Orthopaedic Patients with External Fixators
summary: Pin sites represent the interface where a metal pin or wire from the external environment passes through the skin into the internal environment of the limb. These pins or wires connect an external fixator to the bone to stabilize the bone segments in a patient with trauma or deformity. Because these pin sites represent an opportunity for external skin flora to enter the internal environment of the limb, infections of the pin site are common. These pin site infections are painful, annoying, and cause increased morbidity to the patients. Improving the identification and management of pin site infections would greatly enhance the patient experience when external fixators are used. For this, this paper collects and produces a dataset on pin sites wound infections and proposes a deep learning (DL) method to classify pin sites images based on their appearance: Group A displayed signs of inflammation or infection, while Group B showed no evident complications. Unlike studies that primarily focus on open wounds, our research includes potential interventions at the metal pin/skin interface. Our attention-based deep learning model addresses this complexity by emphasizing relevant regions and minimizing distractions from the pins. Moreover, we introduce an Efficient Redundant Reconstruction Convolution (ERRC) method to enhance the richness of feature maps while reducing the number of parameters. Our model outperforms baseline methods with an AUC of 0.975 and an F1-score of 0.927, requiring only 5.77 M parameters. These results highlight the potential of DL in differentiating pin sites only based on visual signs of infection, aligning with healthcare professional assessments, while further validation with more data remains essential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的针道感染分类方法，通过注意力机制和高效冗余重建卷积技术，在针道图像数据集上实现了高精度的感染识别。
AI.motivation: 针道是外固定器与骨骼连接的接口，容易发生感染，给患者带来疼痛和并发症。目前缺乏有效的针道感染自动识别方法，传统方法主要关注开放性伤口，而忽略了金属针/皮肤界面的特殊性。
AI.method: 收集并创建了针道伤口感染数据集，提出基于注意力的深度学习模型，强调相关区域并减少针体干扰。引入高效冗余重建卷积（ERRC）方法，在减少参数的同时增强特征图的丰富性。
AI.result: 模型在AUC达到0.975，F1分数0.927，仅需5.77M参数，优于基线方法。能够基于视觉特征准确区分感染（A组）和无并发症（B组）的针道图像。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习在仅基于视觉感染征象区分针道方面具有潜力，与医疗专业人员评估一致。虽然需要更多数据验证，但该方法有望改善针道感染的识别和管理，提升患者体验。

title: ElephantBroker: A Knowledge-Grounded Cognitive Runtime for Trustworthy AI Agents
summary: Large Language Model based agents increasingly operate in high stakes, multi turn settings where factual grounding is critical, yet their memory systems typically rely on flat key value stores or plain vector retrieval with no mechanism to track the provenance or trustworthiness of stored knowledge. We present ElephantBroker, an open source cognitive runtime that unifies a Neo4j knowledge graph with a Qdrant vector store through the Cognee SDK to provide durable, verifiable agent memory. The system implements a complete cognitive loop (store, retrieve, score, compose, protect, learn) comprising a hybrid five source retrieval pipeline, an eleven dimension competitive scoring engine for budget constrained context assembly, a four state evidence verification model, a five stage context lifecycle with goal aware assembly and continuous compaction, a six layer cheap first guard pipeline for safety enforcement, an AI firewall providing enforceable tool call interception and multi tier safety scanning, a nine stage consolidation engine that strengthens useful patterns while decaying noise, and a numeric authority model governing multi organization identity with hierarchical access control. Architectural validation through a comprehensive test suite of over 2,200 tests spanning unit, integration, and end to end levels confirms subsystem correctness. The modular design supports three deployment tiers, five profile presets with inheritance, multi gateway isolation, and a management dashboard for human oversight, enabling configurations from lightweight memory only agents to full cognitive runtimes with enterprise grade safety and auditability.

AI.tldr: ElephantBroker是一个开源认知运行时，将Neo4j知识图谱与Qdrant向量存储结合，为LLM代理提供可验证的记忆系统，包含完整的认知循环、混合检索、评分引擎、证据验证和安全防护等功能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在需要事实基础的高风险多轮对话中，其记忆系统通常依赖简单的键值存储或向量检索，缺乏追踪知识来源和可信度的机制，需要更可靠、可验证的记忆系统。
AI.method: 通过Cognee SDK统一Neo4j知识图谱和Qdrant向量存储，实现完整的认知循环：存储、检索、评分、组合、保护、学习。包含混合五源检索管道、十一维竞争评分引擎、四状态证据验证模型、五阶段上下文生命周期、六层廉价优先防护管道、AI防火墙、九阶段整合引擎和数字权威模型。
AI.result: 通过包含2200多个测试的综合测试套件验证了子系统正确性。支持三层部署、五个配置文件预设、多网关隔离和管理仪表板，可实现从轻量级内存代理到具有企业级安全性和可审计性的完整认知运行时的配置。
AI.conclusion: ElephantBroker提供了一个统一、可验证的代理记忆系统，解决了当前LLM代理在事实基础和可信度追踪方面的局限性，为高风险应用场景提供了企业级的安全和审计能力。

title: A Catalog of Basque Dialectal Resources: Online Collections and Standard-to-Dialectal Adaptations
summary: Recent research on dialectal NLP has identified data scarcity as a primary limitation. To address this limitation, this paper presents a catalog of contemporary Basque dialectal data and resources, offering a systematic and comprehensive compilation of the dialectal data currently available in Basque. Two types of data sources have been distinguished: online data originally written in some dialect, and standard-to-dialect adapted data. The former includes all dialectal data that can be found online, such as news and radio sites, informal tweets, as well as online resources such as dictionaries, atlases, grammar rules, or videos. The latter consists of data that has been adapted from the standard variety to dialectal varieties, either manually or automatically. Regarding the manual adaptation, the test split of the XNLI Natural Language Inference dataset was manually adapted into three Basque dialects: Western, Central, and Navarrese-Lapurdian, yielding a high-quality parallel gold standard evaluation dataset. With respect to the automatic dialectal adaptation, the automatically adapted physical commonsense dataset (BasPhyCowest) underwent additional manual evaluation by native speakers to assess its quality and determine whether it could serve as a viable substitute for full manual adaptation (i.e., silver data creation).

AI.tldr: 本文构建了巴斯克语方言数据的系统性目录，包含在线原生方言数据和标准语到方言的适配数据，为方言NLP研究提供了资源基础。
AI.motivation: 方言NLP研究面临数据稀缺的主要限制，本文旨在通过系统整理巴斯克语方言数据资源来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 区分两类数据源：1) 在线原生方言数据（新闻、推文、词典等）；2) 标准语到方言的适配数据，包括手动适配XNLI测试集到三个方言，以及自动适配BasPhyCowest数据集并人工评估质量。
AI.result: 创建了巴斯克语方言数据目录，生成了高质量的XNLI平行评估数据集，评估了自动适配数据的质量，为方言NLP提供了资源基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供的系统性方言数据目录和资源有助于缓解巴斯克语方言NLP的数据稀缺问题，为相关研究提供了重要支持。

title: Generative Adversarial Perturbations with Cross-paradigm Transferability on Localized Crowd Counting
summary: State-of-the-art crowd counting and localization are primarily modeled using two paradigms: density maps and point regression. Given the field's security ramifications, there is active interest in model robustness against adversarial attacks. Recent studies have demonstrated transferability across density-map-based approaches via adversarial patches, but cross-paradigm attacks (i.e., across both density map-based models and point regression-based models) remain unexplored. We introduce a novel adversarial framework that compromises both density map and point regression architectural paradigms through a comprehensive multi-task loss optimization. For point-regression models, we employ scene-density-specific high-confidence logit suppression; for density-map approaches, we use peak-targeted density map suppression. Both are combined with model-agnostic perceptual constraints to ensure that perturbations are effective and imperceptible to the human eye. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our attack, achieving on average a 7X increase in Mean Absolute Error compared to clean images while maintaining competitive visual quality, and successfully transferring across seven state-of-the-art crowd models with transfer ratios ranging from 0.55 to 1.69. Our approach strikes a balance between attack effectiveness and imperceptibility compared to state-of-the-art transferable attack strategies. The source code is available at https://github.com/simurgh7/CrowdGen

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的对抗攻击框架，能够同时攻击密度图模型和点回归模型，通过多任务损失优化实现跨范式攻击，在保持视觉质量的同时显著降低模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前人群计数和定位主要使用密度图和点回归两种范式，现有对抗攻击研究主要集中在密度图模型之间的可迁移性，而跨范式攻击（同时攻击密度图和点回归模型）尚未被探索。考虑到该领域的安全影响，需要研究能够同时攻击两种架构范式的对抗攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出一个新颖的对抗攻击框架，通过综合多任务损失优化来攻击两种范式：对于点回归模型，采用场景密度特定的高置信度logit抑制；对于密度图方法，使用峰值目标密度图抑制。两者结合模型无关的感知约束，确保扰动既有效又对人眼不可察觉。
AI.result: 实验表明该攻击方法非常有效，与干净图像相比平均将平均绝对误差提高了7倍，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。成功在7个最先进的人群模型之间迁移，迁移比在0.55到1.69之间。相比现有可迁移攻击策略，在攻击效果和不可察觉性之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次探索了跨范式对抗攻击，提出的框架能够有效攻击密度图和点回归两种人群计数模型，在保持视觉质量的同时显著降低模型性能，为人群计数系统的安全性评估提供了新视角。

title: When Sensing Varies with Contexts: Context-as-Transform for Tactile Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) can be particularly susceptible to acquisition contexts with only a few labeled samples. A typical scenario is tactile sensing, where the acquisition context ({\it e.g.}, diverse devices, contact state, and interaction settings) degrades performance due to a lack of standardization. In this paper, we propose Context-as-Transform FSCIL (CaT-FSCIL) to tackle the above problem. We decompose the acquisition context into a structured low-dimensional component and a high-dimensional residual component. The former can be easily affected by tactile interaction features, which are modeled as an approximately invertible Context-as-Transform family and handled via inverse-transform canonicalization optimized with a pseudo-context consistency loss. The latter mainly arises from platform and device differences, which can be mitigated with an Uncertainty-Conditioned Prototype Calibration (UCPC) that calibrates biased prototypes and decision boundaries based on context uncertainty. Comprehensive experiments on the standard benchmarks HapTex and LMT108 have demonstrated the superiority of the proposed CaT-FSCIL.

AI.tldr: CaT-FSCIL通过将采集上下文分解为结构化低维分量和高维残差分量，分别用可逆变换规范化和不确定性条件原型校准来处理，以解决少样本类增量学习在触觉感知中的上下文敏感问题。
AI.motivation: 少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）在只有少量标记样本的采集上下文中特别敏感。触觉感知场景中，由于缺乏标准化，不同的设备、接触状态和交互设置等采集上下文会显著降低性能。
AI.method: 1. 将采集上下文分解为结构化低维分量和高维残差分量；2. 低维分量受触觉交互特征影响，建模为近似可逆的Context-as-Transform族，通过伪上下文一致性损失优化的逆变换规范化处理；3. 高维残差主要来自平台和设备差异，通过不确定性条件原型校准（UCPC）基于上下文不确定性校准有偏原型和决策边界。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集HapTex和LMT108上的综合实验证明了CaT-FSCIL的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的CaT-FSCIL方法通过分解和处理采集上下文的不同分量，有效解决了触觉感知中少样本类增量学习的上下文敏感问题，在标准基准上表现出色。

title: DCARL: A Divide-and-Conquer Framework for Autoregressive Long-Trajectory Video Generation
summary: Long-trajectory video generation is a crucial yet challenging task for world modeling primarily due to the limited scalability of existing video diffusion models (VDMs). Autoregressive models, while offering infinite rollout, suffer from visual drift and poor controllability. To address these issues, we propose DCARL, a novel divide-and-conquer, autoregressive framework that effectively combines the structural stability of the divide-and-conquer scheme with the high-fidelity generation of VDMs. Our approach first employs a dedicated Keyframe Generator trained without temporal compression to establish long-range, globally consistent structural anchors. Subsequently, an Interpolation Generator synthesizes the dense frames in an autoregressive manner with overlapping segments, utilizing the keyframes for global context and a single clean preceding frame for local coherence. Trained on a large-scale internet long trajectory video dataset, our method achieves superior performance in both visual quality (lower FID and FVD) and camera adherence (lower ATE and ARE) compared to state-of-the-art autoregressive and divide-and-conquer baselines, demonstrating stable and high-fidelity generation for long trajectory videos up to 32 seconds in length.

AI.tldr: DCARL是一个新颖的分治自回归框架，通过关键帧生成器和插值生成器的结合，解决了长轨迹视频生成中的视觉漂移和可控性问题，实现了长达32秒的高质量视频生成。
AI.motivation: 长轨迹视频生成对于世界建模至关重要，但现有视频扩散模型（VDMs）可扩展性有限。自回归模型虽然能实现无限扩展，但存在视觉漂移和可控性差的问题。
AI.method: 提出DCARL分治自回归框架：1）使用未经时间压缩训练的关键帧生成器建立长距离、全局一致的结构锚点；2）插值生成器以自回归方式合成密集帧，利用关键帧提供全局上下文，单个干净的前一帧确保局部连贯性。
AI.result: 在大规模互联网长轨迹视频数据集上训练，在视觉质量（更低的FID和FVD）和相机一致性（更低的ATE和ARE）方面优于最先进的自回归和分治基线方法，实现了长达32秒的稳定高质量视频生成。
AI.conclusion: DCARL通过分治自回归框架，有效结合了分治方案的结构稳定性和视频扩散模型的高保真生成能力，解决了长轨迹视频生成中的关键挑战。

title: RubricEval: A Rubric-Level Meta-Evaluation Benchmark for LLM Judges in Instruction Following
summary: Rubric-based evaluation has become a prevailing paradigm for evaluating instruction following in large language models (LLMs). Despite its widespread use, the reliability of these rubric-level evaluations remains unclear, calling for meta-evaluation. However, prior meta-evaluation efforts largely focus on the response level, failing to assess the fine-grained judgment accuracy that rubric-based evaluation relies on. To bridge this gap, we introduce RubricEval. Our benchmark features: (1) the first rubric-level meta-evaluation benchmark for instruction following, (2) diverse instructions and responses spanning multiple categories and model sources, and (3) a substantial set of 3,486 quality-controlled instances, along with Easy/Hard subsets that better differentiates judge performance. Our experiments reveal that rubric-level judging remains far from solved: even GPT-4o, a widely adopted judge in instruction-following benchmarks, achieves only 55.97% on Hard subset. Considering evaluation paradigm, rubric-level evaluation outperforms checklist-level, explicit reasoning improves accuracy, and both together reduce inter-judge variance. Through our established rubric taxonomy, we further identify common failure modes and offer actionable insights for reliable instruction-following evaluation.

AI.tldr: RubricEval是首个针对指令遵循评估的细粒度评分标准级别元评估基准，揭示了当前评分标准级别评估的局限性，GPT-4o在困难子集上仅达到55.97%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于评分标准的评估已成为评估大语言模型指令遵循能力的主流范式，但其可靠性尚不明确，需要元评估。先前的研究主要集中在响应级别，未能评估评分标准级别评估所依赖的细粒度判断准确性。
AI.method: 提出RubricEval基准，包含：(1)首个指令遵循的评分标准级别元评估基准；(2)涵盖多个类别和模型来源的多样化指令和响应；(3)3,486个质量控制实例，以及能更好区分评估者性能的简单/困难子集。
AI.result: 实验显示评分标准级别评估远未解决：即使是广泛使用的GPT-4o评估者，在困难子集上仅达到55.97%准确率。评分标准级别评估优于检查表级别，显式推理提高准确性，两者结合减少评估者间方差。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立的评分标准分类法，识别了常见失败模式，并为可靠的指令遵循评估提供了可行见解。评分标准级别评估需要进一步改进以确保评估的可靠性。

title: WAFT-Stereo: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Stereo Matching
summary: We introduce WAFT-Stereo, a simple and effective warping-based method for stereo matching. WAFT-Stereo demonstrates that cost volumes, a common design used in many leading methods, are not necessary for strong performance and can be replaced by warping with improved efficiency. WAFT-Stereo ranks first on ETH3D, KITTI and Middlebury public benchmarks, reducing the zero-shot error by 81% on ETH3D benchmark, while being 1.8-6.7x faster than competitive methods. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT-Stereo.

AI.tldr: WAFT-Stereo是一种基于warping的立体匹配方法，无需cost volumes，在多个基准测试中排名第一，同时速度更快
AI.motivation: 传统立体匹配方法广泛使用cost volumes，但这种方法效率较低。研究者希望证明cost volumes并非必要，可以通过更高效的warping操作替代，同时保持甚至提升性能。
AI.method: WAFT-Stereo采用基于warping的简单有效方法，完全摒弃了传统方法中常见的cost volumes设计，通过warping操作实现立体匹配。
AI.result: 在ETH3D、KITTI和Middlebury公开基准测试中排名第一，在ETH3D基准上的zero-shot错误率降低了81%，速度比竞争方法快1.8-6.7倍。
AI.conclusion: WAFT-Stereo证明了cost volumes对于高性能立体匹配并非必要，可以通过更高效的warping方法替代，在保持卓越性能的同时显著提升效率。

title: UniAI-GraphRAG: Synergizing Ontology-Guided Extraction, Multi-Dimensional Clustering, and Dual-Channel Fusion for Robust Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems face significant challenges in complex reasoning, multi-hop queries, and domain-specific QA. While existing GraphRAG frameworks have made progress in structural knowledge organization, they still have limitations in cross-industry adaptability, community report integrity, and retrieval performance. This paper proposes UniAI-GraphRAG, an enhanced framework built upon open-source GraphRAG. The framework introduces three core innovations: (1) Ontology-Guided Knowledge Extraction that uses predefined Schema to guide LLMs in accurately identifying domain-specific entities and relations; (2) Multi-Dimensional Community Clustering Strategy that improves community completeness through alignment completion, attribute-based clustering, and multi-hop relationship clustering; (3) Dual-Channel Graph Retrieval Fusion that balances QA accuracy and performance through hybrid graph and community retrieval. Evaluation results on MultiHopRAG benchmark show that UniAI-GraphRAG outperforms mainstream open source solutions (e.g.LightRAG) in comprehensive F1 scores, particularly in inference and temporal queries. The code is available at https://github.com/UnicomAI/wanwu/tree/main/rag/rag_open_source/rag_core/graph.

AI.tldr: UniAI-GraphRAG是一个增强的图检索增强生成框架，通过本体引导知识提取、多维社区聚类策略和双通道图检索融合，在复杂推理和多跳查询任务中优于现有开源解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG系统在处理复杂推理、多跳查询和领域特定QA时面临挑战，而现有GraphRAG框架在跨行业适应性、社区报告完整性和检索性能方面仍有局限。
AI.method: 提出三个核心创新：1) 本体引导知识提取，使用预定义Schema指导LLMs准确识别领域特定实体和关系；2) 多维社区聚类策略，通过对齐补全、基于属性聚类和多跳关系聚类提高社区完整性；3) 双通道图检索融合，通过混合图和社区检索平衡QA准确性和性能。
AI.result: 在MultiHopRAG基准测试中，UniAI-GraphRAG在综合F1分数上优于主流开源解决方案（如LightRAG），特别是在推理和时间查询方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: UniAI-GraphRAG通过创新的知识提取、社区聚类和检索融合方法，显著提升了RAG系统在复杂推理任务中的性能，为领域特定QA和多跳查询提供了有效解决方案。

title: Translation or Recitation? Calibrating Evaluation Scores for Machine Translation of Extremely Low-Resource Languages
summary: The landscape of extremely low-resource machine translation (MT) is characterized by perplexing variability in reported performance, often making results across different language pairs difficult to contextualize. For researchers focused on specific language groups -- such as ancient languages -- it is nearly impossible to determine if breakthroughs reported in other contexts (e.g., native African or American languages) result from superior methodologies or are merely artifacts of benchmark collection. To address this problem, we introduce the FRED Difficulty Metrics, which include the Fertility Ratio (F), Retrieval Proxy (R), Pre-training Exposure (E), and Corpus Diversity (D) and serve as dataset-intrinsic metrics to contextualize reported scores. These metrics reveal that a significant portion of result variability is explained by train-test overlap and pre-training exposure rather than model capability. Additionally, we identify that some languages -- particularly extinct and non-Latin indigenous languages -- suffer from poor tokenization coverage (high token fertility), highlighting a fundamental limitation of transferring models from high-resource languages that lack a shared vocabulary. By providing these indices alongside performance scores, we enable more transparent evaluation of cross-lingual transfer and provide a more reliable foundation for the XLR MT community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FRED难度指标（Fertility Ratio、Retrieval Proxy、Pre-training Exposure、Corpus Diversity）来量化低资源机器翻译数据集的内在难度，解释性能差异主要源于训练-测试重叠和预训练暴露而非模型能力，特别指出灭绝和非拉丁土著语言存在词汇覆盖问题。
AI.motivation: 极低资源机器翻译领域存在性能报告的高度变异性，使得不同语言对的结果难以比较。对于专注于特定语言群体（如古代语言）的研究者来说，很难判断其他语境（如非洲或美洲土著语言）报告的突破是由于优越方法还是基准收集的偶然性。需要建立数据集内在指标来标准化评估。
AI.method: 提出了FRED难度指标：Fertility Ratio（F，词汇覆盖率）、Retrieval Proxy（R，训练-测试重叠度）、Pre-training Exposure（E，预训练暴露程度）、Corpus Diversity（D，语料多样性）。这些指标作为数据集内在特征，用于量化翻译任务的固有难度，帮助解释性能差异。
AI.result: 研究发现性能变异性很大程度上可由训练-测试重叠和预训练暴露解释，而非模型能力差异。特别指出灭绝语言和非拉丁土著语言存在严重的词汇覆盖问题（高token fertility），这揭示了从高资源语言迁移模型时缺乏共享词汇的根本限制。
AI.conclusion: FRED指标为极低资源机器翻译社区提供了更透明的评估框架，通过将性能分数与这些难度指标结合报告，能够更可靠地评估跨语言迁移效果，为领域建立更坚实的研究基础。

title: NeuroVLM-Bench: Evaluation of Vision-Enabled Large Language Models for Clinical Reasoning in Neurological Disorders
comment: 53 pages, 12 figures. Manuscript submitted to the BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making journal
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models enable new possibilities for image-based decision support. However, their reliability and operational trade-offs in neuroimaging remain insufficiently understood. We present a comprehensive benchmarking study of vision-enabled large language models for 2D neuroimaging using curated MRI and CT datasets covering multiple sclerosis, stroke, brain tumors, other abnormalities, and normal controls. Models are required to generate multiple outputs simultaneously, including diagnosis, diagnosis subtype, imaging modality, specialized sequence, and anatomical plane. Performance is evaluated across four directions: discriminative classification with abstention, calibration, structured-output validity, and computational efficiency. A multi-phase framework ensures fair comparison while controlling for selection bias. Across twenty frontier multimodal models, the results show that technical imaging attributes such as modality and plane are nearly solved, whereas diagnostic reasoning, especially subtype prediction, remains challenging. Tumor classification emerges as the most reliable task, stroke is moderately solvable, while multiple sclerosis and rare abnormalities remain difficult. Few-shot prompting improves performance for several models but increases token usage, latency, and cost. Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5-Chat achieve the strongest overall diagnostic performance, while Gemini-2.5-Flash offers the best efficiency-performance trade-off. Among open-weight architectures, MedGemma-1.5-4B demonstrates the most promising results, as under few-shot prompting, it approaches the zero-shot performance of several proprietary models, while maintaining perfect structured output. These findings provide practical insights into performance, reliability, and efficiency trade-offs, supporting standardized evaluation of multimodal LLMs in neuroimaging.

AI.tldr: 该研究对20种前沿多模态大语言模型在神经影像诊断中的性能进行了全面基准测试，发现技术性影像属性（如模态和平面）已基本解决，但诊断推理尤其是亚型预测仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在图像决策支持方面展现出新潜力，但其在神经影像领域的可靠性和操作权衡尚未得到充分理解，需要进行系统评估以指导临床应用。
AI.method: 使用包含多发性硬化、中风、脑肿瘤、其他异常和正常对照的MRI和CT数据集，要求模型同时生成诊断、诊断亚型、成像模态、专业序列和解剖平面等多个输出，通过四阶段框架进行公平比较，评估分类性能、校准度、结构化输出有效性和计算效率。
AI.result: Gemini-2.5-Pro和GPT-5-Chat在诊断性能上表现最强，Gemini-2.5-Flash在效率-性能权衡上最佳；开放权重模型中MedGemma-1.5-4B最有前景，其少样本提示性能接近多个专有模型的零样本性能；肿瘤分类最可靠，中风中等可解，多发性硬化和罕见异常仍困难。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多模态大语言模型在神经影像中的性能、可靠性和效率权衡提供了实用见解，支持该领域的标准化评估，有助于临床决策支持系统的开发和应用。

title: Trace2Skill: Distill Trajectory-Local Lessons into Transferable Agent Skills
summary: Equipping Large Language Model (LLM) agents with domain-specific skills is critical for tackling complex tasks. Yet, manual authoring creates a severe scalability bottleneck. Conversely, automated skill generation often yields fragile or fragmented results because it either relies on shallow parametric knowledge or sequentially overfits to non-generalizable trajectory-local lessons. To overcome this, we introduce Trace2Skill, a framework that mirrors how human experts author skills: by holistically analyzing broad execution experience before distilling it into a single, comprehensive guide. Instead of reacting sequentially to individual trajectories, Trace2Skill dispatches a parallel fleet of sub-agents to analyze a diverse pool of executions. It extracts trajectory-specific lessons and hierarchically consolidates them into a unified, conflict-free skill directory via inductive reasoning. Trace2Skill supports both deepening existing human-written skills and creating new ones from scratch. Experiments in challenging domains, such as spreadsheet, VisionQA and math reasoning, show that Trace2Skill significantly improves upon strong baselines, including Anthropic's official xlsx skills. Crucially, this trajectory-grounded evolution does not merely memorize task instances or model-specific quirks: evolved skills transfer across LLM scales and generalize to OOD settings. For example, skills evolved by Qwen3.5-35B on its own trajectories improved a Qwen3.5-122B agent by up to 57.65 absolute percentage points on WikiTableQuestions. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that complex agent experience can be packaged into highly transferable, declarative skills -- requiring no parameter updates, no external retrieval modules, and utilizing open-source models as small as 35B parameters.

AI.tldr: Trace2Skill框架通过并行分析多样化执行轨迹，提取并层次化整合为统一的技能目录，显著提升LLM代理在复杂任务中的表现，且技能可跨模型规模迁移。
AI.motivation: 为大型语言模型代理配备领域特定技能对于处理复杂任务至关重要，但手动编写技能存在可扩展性瓶颈，而现有的自动技能生成方法往往产生脆弱或碎片化的结果。
AI.method: Trace2Skill框架模拟人类专家编写技能的方式：并行派遣子代理分析多样化执行轨迹池，提取轨迹特定经验教训，通过归纳推理层次化整合为统一、无冲突的技能目录。
AI.result: 在电子表格、视觉问答和数学推理等挑战性领域实验中，Trace2Skill显著优于包括Anthropic官方xlsx技能在内的强基线。进化后的技能可跨LLM规模迁移并泛化到分布外设置。
AI.conclusion: Trace2Skill能够将复杂的代理经验打包成高度可迁移的声明性技能，无需参数更新、外部检索模块，且可使用小至35B参数的开源模型实现。

title: Comparing Natural and Synthetic Structured Data: A Study of the Passive Verb Alternation in French and Italian
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, paper accepted at the Workshop on Structured Linguistic Data and Evaluation (SLiDE)
summary: This study compares the impact of natural and synthetic data on training and evaluating large language models (LLMs), using the case of passive verb alternation in French and Italian. We use Blackbird Language Matrices (BLMs), structured datasets designed to probe linguistic knowledge of underlying patterns across sentence sets. We compare structured templates instantiated with natural sentences extracted from Universal Dependencies to structured templates of synthetic sentences. Experiments show that while models achieve ceiling performance when trained and tested on synthetic datasets, they do not reliably generalize to natural sentences. In contrast, models trained on natural data exhibit robust performance across both natural and synthetic test suites, demonstrating their superior ability to capture abstract linguistic patterns. These results corroborate the value of natural data and of structured set ups in linguistic evaluation for probing LLMs' syntactic and semantic knowledge.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了自然数据和合成数据对大型语言模型训练和评估的影响，以法语和意大利语被动动词交替为例，发现自然数据训练的模型表现更稳健。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是比较自然数据和合成数据在训练和评估大型语言模型时的效果差异，特别是在探究语言模型对底层语言模式的掌握能力方面。
AI.method: 使用Blackbird Language Matrices（BLMs）结构化数据集，比较从Universal Dependencies提取的自然句子与合成句子的结构化模板，测试模型在法语和意大利语被动动词交替任务上的表现。
AI.result: 实验显示：1）在合成数据上训练和测试的模型能达到天花板性能，但无法可靠地泛化到自然句子；2）在自然数据上训练的模型在自然和合成测试集上都表现出稳健性能，能更好地捕捉抽象语言模式。
AI.conclusion: 自然数据和结构化评估设置对于探究大型语言模型的句法和语义知识具有重要价值，自然数据训练的模型在泛化能力上优于合成数据训练的模型。

title: The Competence Shadow: Theory and Bounds of AI Assistance in Safety Engineering
summary:
As AI assistants become integrated into safety engineering workflows for Physical AI systems, a critical question emerges: does AI assistance improve safety analysis quality, or introduce systematic blind spots that surface only through post-deployment incidents? This paper develops a formal framework for AI assistance in safety analysis. We first establish why safety engineering resists benchmark-driven evaluation: safety competence is irreducibly multidimensional, constrained by context-dependent correctness, inherent incompleteness, and legitimate expert disagreement. We formalize this through a five-dimensional competence framework capturing domain knowledge, standards expertise, operational experience, contextual understanding, and judgment.
  We introduce the competence shadow: the systematic narrowing of human reasoning induced by AI-generated safety analysis. The shadow is not what the AI presents, but what it prevents from being considered. We formalize four canonical human-AI collaboration structures and derive closed-form performance bounds, demonstrating that the competence shadow compounds multiplicatively to produce degradation far exceeding naive additive estimates.
  The central finding is that AI assistance in safety engineering is a collaboration design problem, not a software procurement decision. The same tool degrades or improves analysis quality depending entirely on how it is used. We derive non-degradation conditions for shadow-resistant workflows and call for a shift from tool qualification toward workflow qualification for trustworthy Physical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI辅助安全分析的正式框架，指出AI助手在物理AI系统安全工程中可能产生"能力阴影"——即AI生成的分析会系统性限制人类考虑的范围，导致分析质量下降而非提升。
AI.motivation: 随着AI助手被集成到物理AI系统的安全工程工作流程中，一个关键问题出现：AI辅助是提高了安全分析质量，还是引入了只有在部署后事故中才会显现的系统性盲点？本文旨在开发一个AI辅助安全分析的正式框架。
AI.method: 首先建立了安全工程为何抵制基准驱动评估的理论基础：安全能力是不可简化的多维度的，受限于上下文相关的正确性、固有的不完整性和合理的专家分歧。通过一个五维能力框架（领域知识、标准专业知识、操作经验、上下文理解和判断）来形式化这一概念。引入了"能力阴影"概念，即AI生成的安全分析所诱导的人类推理系统性收窄。形式化了四种典型的人机协作结构，并推导出闭式性能边界。
AI.result: 研究表明能力阴影会以乘法方式复合，产生远超朴素加法估计的退化。推导了非退化条件，为抗阴影工作流程提供了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助安全工程是一个协作设计问题，而非软件采购决策。同一工具可能改善或降低分析质量，完全取决于使用方式。呼吁从工具认证转向工作流程认证，以实现可信的物理AI。

title: MolQuest: A Benchmark for Agentic Evaluation of Abductive Reasoning in Chemical Structure Elucidation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) hold considerable potential for advancing scientific discovery, yet systematic assessment of their dynamic reasoning in real-world research remains limited. Current scientific evaluation benchmarks predominantly rely on static, single-turn Question Answering (QA) formats, which are inadequate for measuring model performance in complex scientific tasks that require multi-step iteration and experimental interaction. To address this gap, we introduce MolQuest, a novel agent-based evaluation framework for molecular structure elucidation built upon authentic chemical experimental data. Unlike existing datasets, MolQuest formalizes molecular structure elucidation as a multi-turn interactive task, requiring models to proactively plan experimental steps, integrate heterogeneous spectral sources (e.g., NMR, MS), and iteratively refine structural hypotheses. This framework systematically evaluates LLMs' abductive reasoning and strategic decision-making abilities within a vast and complex chemical space. Empirical results reveal that contemporary frontier models exhibit significant limitations in authentic scientific scenarios: notably, even state-of-the-art (SOTA) models achieve an accuracy of only approximately 50%, while the performance of most other models remains below the 30% threshold. This work provides a reproducible and extensible framework for science-oriented LLM evaluation, our findings highlight the critical gap in current LLMs' strategic scientific reasoning, setting a clear direction for future research toward AI that can actively participate in the scientific process.

AI.tldr: MolQuest是一个基于真实化学实验数据的分子结构解析评估框架，将分子结构解析定义为多轮交互任务，评估LLMs在复杂化学空间中的溯因推理和战略决策能力。
AI.motivation: 当前科学评估基准主要依赖静态、单轮问答格式，无法衡量模型在需要多步迭代和实验交互的复杂科学任务中的表现。需要系统评估LLMs在真实科学研究中的动态推理能力。
AI.method: 引入MolQuest，一个基于代理的分子结构解析评估框架，使用真实化学实验数据。该框架将分子结构解析形式化为多轮交互任务，要求模型主动规划实验步骤、整合异质光谱源（如NMR、MS），并迭代优化结构假设。
AI.result: 实证结果显示，当前前沿模型在真实科学场景中存在显著局限性：即使是SOTA模型准确率也只有约50%，而大多数其他模型性能低于30%阈值。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为面向科学的LLM评估提供了一个可重复和可扩展的框架，研究结果突显了当前LLMs战略科学推理能力的关键差距，为未来研究AI积极参与科学过程设定了明确方向。

title: Probabilistic Abstract Interpretation on Neural Networks via Grids Approximation
summary: Probabilistic abstract interpretation is a theory used to extract particular properties of a computer program when it is infeasible to test every single inputs. In this paper we apply the theory on neural networks for the same purpose: to analyse density distribution flow of all possible inputs of a neural network when a network has uncountably many or countable but infinitely many inputs. We show how this theoretical framework works in neural networks and then discuss different abstract domains and corresponding Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverses together with abstract transformers used in the framework. We also present experimental examples to show how this framework helps to analyse real world problems.

AI.tldr: 将概率抽象解释理论应用于神经网络分析，研究无限输入空间下的密度分布流，提出抽象域、伪逆和抽象变换器框架
AI.motivation: 当神经网络具有不可数或可数无限输入时，传统测试方法无法覆盖所有输入，需要理论框架来分析所有可能输入的密度分布流
AI.method: 应用概率抽象解释理论，研究不同抽象域及其对应的Moore-Penrose伪逆，设计抽象变换器来分析神经网络的密度分布流
AI.result: 展示了理论框架在神经网络中的工作原理，提供了不同抽象域和伪逆的讨论，并通过实验示例验证了框架在现实问题分析中的有效性
AI.conclusion: 概率抽象解释理论为分析具有无限输入空间的神经网络提供了有效的理论框架，能够帮助理解输入密度分布流并解决实际问题

title: CRAFT: Grounded Multi-Agent Coordination Under Partial Information
summary: We introduce CRAFT, a multi-agent benchmark for evaluating pragmatic communication in large language models under strict partial information. In this setting, multiple agents with complementary but incomplete views must coordinate through natural language to construct a shared 3D structure that no single agent can fully observe. We formalize this problem as a multi-sender pragmatic reasoning task and provide a diagnostic framework that decomposes failures into spatial grounding, belief modeling and pragmatic communication errors, including a taxonomy of behavioral failure profiles in both frontier and open-weight models. Across a diverse set of models, including 8 open-weight and 7 frontier including reasoning models, we find that stronger reasoning ability does not reliably translate to better coordination: smaller open-weight models often match or outperform frontier systems, and improved individual communication does not guarantee successful collaboration. These results suggest that multi-agent coordination remains a fundamentally unsolved challenge for current language models. Our code can be found at https://github.com/csu-signal/CRAFT

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一个多智能体基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在严格部分信息下的语用通信能力。多个智能体拥有互补但不完整的视角，需要通过自然语言协调构建一个没有任何单个智能体能完全观察到的共享3D结构。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在多智能体协调方面存在挑战，特别是在严格部分信息设置下。需要评估模型在需要语用推理和协调的场景中的表现，了解推理能力是否真正转化为有效的协作能力。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为多发送者语用推理任务，提供诊断框架，将失败分解为空间基础、信念建模和语用通信错误。包括对前沿模型和开源模型的行为失败模式分类。评估了15个模型（8个开源模型和7个前沿推理模型）。
AI.result: 更强的推理能力并不能可靠地转化为更好的协调能力：较小的开源模型经常匹配或超越前沿系统，改进的个体通信能力并不能保证成功的协作。多智能体协调仍然是当前语言模型未解决的根本挑战。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协调是当前语言模型的一个基本未解难题，需要超越单纯推理能力的专门协调能力。CRAFT基准提供了评估和诊断这些挑战的工具。

title: OptiSAR-Net++: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Transformer-Free Framework for Cross-Domain Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
summary: Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to localize specific targets in remote sensing images using natural language expressions. However, existing methods are restricted to single-sensor domains, i.e., either optical or synthetic aperture radar (SAR), limiting their real-world applicability. In this paper, we introduce the Cross-Domain RSVG (CD-RSVG) task and construct OptSAR-RSVG, the first large-scale benchmark dataset for this setting. To tackle the challenges of cross-domain feature modeling, computational inefficiency, and fine-grained semantic discrimination, we propose OptiSAR-Net++. Our framework features a patch-level Low-Rank Adaptation Mixture of Experts (PL-MoE) for efficient cross-domain feature decoupling. To mitigate the substantial computational overhead of Transformer decoding frameworks, we adopt a CLIP-based contrastive paradigm and further incorporate dynamic adversarial negative sampling, thereby transforming generative regression into an efficient cross-modal matching process. Additionally, a text-guided dual-gate fusion module (TGDF-SSA) and a region-aware auxiliary head are introduced to enhance semantic-visual alignment and spatial modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OptiSAR-Net++ achieves SOTA performance on both OptSAR-RSVG and DIOR-RSVG benchmarks, offering significant advantages in localization accuracy and efficiency. Our code and dataset will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出跨域遥感视觉定位任务CD-RSVG，构建首个大规模数据集OptSAR-RSVG，并提出OptiSAR-Net++框架，通过PL-MoE、CLIP对比范式、动态对抗负采样等创新方法，在定位精度和效率上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感视觉定位方法局限于单一传感器域（光学或SAR），限制了实际应用。需要解决跨域特征建模、计算效率低和细粒度语义判别等挑战。
AI.method: 提出OptiSAR-Net++框架：1) PL-MoE用于高效跨域特征解耦；2) 采用CLIP对比范式+动态对抗负采样，将生成式回归转为高效跨模态匹配；3) 文本引导双门融合模块(TGDF-SSA)增强语义-视觉对齐；4) 区域感知辅助头提升空间建模。
AI.result: 在OptSAR-RSVG和DIOR-RSVG基准测试中达到SOTA性能，在定位精度和效率方面具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 成功解决了跨域遥感视觉定位问题，提出的框架在精度和效率上均表现优异，为实际应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Distribution and Clusters Approximations as Abstract Domains in Probabilistic Abstract Interpretation to Neural Network Analysis
summary: The probabilistic abstract interpretation framework of neural network analysis analyzes a neural network by analyzing its density distribution flow of all possible inputs. The grids approximation is one of abstract domains the framework uses which abstracts concrete space into grids. In this paper, we introduce two novel approximation methods: distribution approximation and clusters approximation. We show how these two methods work in theory with corresponding abstract transformers with help of illustrations of some simple examples.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种新的神经网络概率抽象解释近似方法：分布近似和聚类近似，用于分析神经网络输入的概率分布流
AI.motivation: 概率抽象解释框架通过分析所有可能输入的密度分布流来分析神经网络，其中网格近似是现有抽象域之一。需要开发更有效的近似方法来改进神经网络分析。
AI.method: 提出两种新颖的近似方法：1) 分布近似，2) 聚类近似。通过理论分析和抽象转换器的设计，结合简单示例的图示说明这些方法的工作原理。
AI.result: 展示了这两种新近似方法在理论上的可行性，并通过具体示例说明了它们如何在实际中工作，为神经网络分析提供了新的抽象域选项。
AI.conclusion: 分布近似和聚类近似是概率抽象解释框架的有效补充，扩展了神经网络分析的抽象域选择，为更精确的神经网络行为分析提供了新工具。

title: Self-Supervised Learning for Knee Osteoarthritis: Diagnostic Limitations and Prognostic Value of Uncurated Hospital Data
summary: This study assesses whether self-supervised learning (SSL) improves knee osteoarthritis (OA) modeling for diagnosis and prognosis relative to ImageNet-pretrained initialization. We compared (i) image-only SSL pretrained on knee radiographs from the OAI, MOST, and NYU cohorts, and (ii) multimodal image-text SSL pretrained on uncurated hospital knee radiographs paired with radiologist impressions. For diagnostic Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grade prediction, SSL offered mixed results. While image-only SSL improved accuracy during linear probing (frozen encoder), it did not outperform ImageNet pretraining during full fine-tuning. Similarly, multimodal SSL failed to improve grading performance. We attribute this to severe bias in the uncurated hospital pretraining corpus (93% estimated KL grade 3), which limited alignment with the balanced diagnostic task. In contrast, this same multimodal initialization significantly improved prognostic modeling. It outperformed ImageNet baselines in predicting 4-year structural incidence and progression, including on external validation (MOST AUROC: 0.701 vs. 0.599 at 10% labeled data). Overall, while uncurated hospital image-text data may be ineffective for learning diagnosis due to severity bias, it provides a strong signal for prognostic modeling when the downstream task aligns with pretraining data distribution

AI.tldr: 自监督学习在膝关节骨关节炎诊断和预后建模中的效果评估：图像自监督在诊断任务中表现不一，多模态自监督因数据偏倚在诊断中无效，但在预后预测中显著优于ImageNet预训练
AI.motivation: 评估自监督学习是否比ImageNet预训练初始化能更好地改善膝关节骨关节炎的诊断和预后建模，特别比较图像自监督和多模态图像-文本自监督的效果
AI.method: 比较两种自监督学习方法：(1) 图像自监督：在OAI、MOST和NYU队列的膝关节X光片上预训练；(2) 多模态图像-文本自监督：在未筛选的医院膝关节X光片与放射科医生印象配对的语料上预训练。评估诊断任务（KL分级预测）和预后任务（4年结构发生和进展预测）
AI.result: 诊断任务：图像自监督在线性探测时改善准确率，但在完全微调时不优于ImageNet预训练；多模态自监督因预训练语料严重偏倚（93%为KL 3级）未能改善分级性能。预后任务：多模态初始化显著改善预后建模，在预测4年结构发生和进展上优于ImageNet基线，外部验证中AUROC从0.599提升到0.701（10%标记数据）
AI.conclusion: 未筛选的医院图像-文本数据因严重偏倚不适合学习诊断任务，但当下游任务与预训练数据分布一致时，为预后建模提供了强信号，多模态自监督在预后预测中表现出色

title: SliderQuant: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
comment: This work is accepted to ICLR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/deep-optimization/SliderQuant
summary: In this paper, we address post-training quantization (PTQ) for large language models (LLMs) from an overlooked perspective: given a pre-trained high-precision LLM, the predominant sequential quantization framework treats different layers equally, but this may be not optimal in challenging bit-width settings. We empirically study the quantization impact of different layers on model accuracy, and observe that: (1) shallow/deep layers are usually more sensitive to quantization than intermediate layers; (2) among shallow/deep layers, the most sensitive one is the first/last layer, which exhibits significantly larger quantization error than others. These empirical observations imply that the quantization design for different layers of LLMs is required on multiple levels instead of a single level shared to all layers. Motivated by this, we propose a new PTQ framework termed Sliding-layer Quantization (SliderQuant) that relies on a simple adaptive sliding quantization concept facilitated by few learnable parameters. The base component of SliderQuant is called inter-layer sliding quantization, which incorporates three types of novel sliding window designs tailored for addressing the varying quantization sensitivity of shallow, intermediate and deep layers. The other component is called intra-layer sliding quantization that leverages an incremental strategy to quantize each window. As a result, SliderQuant has a strong ability to reduce quantization errors across layers. Extensive experiments on basic language generation, zero-shot commonsense reasoning and challenging math and code tasks with various LLMs, including Llama/Llama2/Llama3/Qwen2.5 model families, DeepSeek-R1 distilled models and large MoE models, show that our method outperforms existing PTQ methods (including the latest PTQ methods using rotation transformations) for both weight-only quantization and weight-activation quantization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的后训练量化框架SliderQuant，通过自适应滑动量化设计来应对大语言模型中不同层对量化的敏感性差异，显著降低了量化误差。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型后训练量化方法通常对所有层采用相同的量化策略，但研究发现浅层和深层对量化更敏感，特别是第一层和最后一层。这种"一刀切"的方法在低比特量化设置下可能不是最优的。
AI.method: 提出SliderQuant框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 层间滑动量化：针对浅层、中间层和深层设计三种滑动窗口，适应不同层的量化敏感性；2) 层内滑动量化：采用增量策略量化每个窗口。框架仅需少量可学习参数。
AI.result: 在基础语言生成、零样本常识推理以及数学和代码任务上，SliderQuant在Llama/Llama2/Llama3/Qwen2.5等多个模型家族、DeepSeek-R1蒸馏模型和大规模MoE模型上均优于现有PTQ方法，包括最新的使用旋转变换的方法。
AI.conclusion: SliderQuant通过自适应滑动量化设计有效解决了大语言模型中不同层量化敏感性的差异问题，为低比特量化提供了更优的解决方案，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了量化误差。

title: ICTPolarReal: A Polarized Reflection and Material Dataset of Real World Objects
summary: Accurately modeling how real-world materials reflect light remains a core challenge in inverse rendering, largely due to the scarcity of real measured reflectance data. Existing approaches rely heavily on synthetic datasets with simplified illumination and limited material realism, preventing models from generalizing to real-world images. We introduce a large-scale polarized reflection and material dataset of real-world objects, captured with an 8-camera, 346-light Light Stage equipped with cross/parallel polarization. Our dataset spans 218 everyday objects across five acquisition dimensions-multiview, multi-illumination, polarization, reflectance separation, and material attributes-yielding over 1.2M high-resolution images with diffuse-specular separation and analytically derived diffuse albedo, specular albedo, and surface normals. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate state-of-the-art inverse and forward rendering models on intrinsic decomposition, relighting, and sparse-view 3D reconstruction, demonstrating significant improvements in material separation, illumination fidelity, and geometric consistency. We hope that our work can establish a new foundation for physically grounded material understanding and enable real-world generalization beyond synthetic training regimes. Project page: https://jingyangcarl.github.io/ICTPolarReal/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个大规模的真实世界偏振反射和材质数据集，使用配备交叉/平行偏振的8相机346光源光舞台采集，包含218个日常物体，超过120万张高分辨率图像，用于改进逆渲染和正向渲染模型。
AI.motivation: 准确建模真实世界材料如何反射光是逆渲染的核心挑战，主要由于缺乏真实的测量反射数据。现有方法严重依赖合成数据集，这些数据集具有简化的照明和有限的材料真实性，导致模型无法泛化到真实世界图像。
AI.method: 引入了一个大规模的真实世界偏振反射和材质数据集，使用配备交叉/平行偏振的8相机346光源光舞台采集。数据集涵盖218个日常物体，跨越五个采集维度：多视角、多照明、偏振、反射分离和材质属性，产生超过120万张高分辨率图像，包含漫反射-镜面反射分离以及分析推导的漫反射反照率、镜面反射反照率和表面法线。
AI.result: 使用该数据集训练和评估了最先进的逆渲染和正向渲染模型，在内在分解、重照明和稀疏视图3D重建方面展示了显著改进，包括材料分离、照明保真度和几何一致性方面的提升。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为基于物理的材料理解建立了新的基础，并实现了超越合成训练机制的真实世界泛化能力。

title: DAGverse: Building Document-Grounded Semantic DAGs from Scientific Papers
summary: Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) are widely used to represent structured knowledge in scientific and technical domains. However, datasets for real-world DAGs remain scarce because constructing them typically requires expert interpretation of domain documents. We study Doc2SemDAG construction: recovering a preferred semantic DAG from a document together with the cited evidence and context that explain it. This problem is challenging because a document may admit multiple plausible abstractions, the intended structure is often implicit, and the supporting evidence is scattered across prose, equations, captions, and figures. To address these challenges, we leverage scientific papers containing explicit DAG figures as a natural source of supervision. In this setting, the DAG figure provides the DAG structure, while the accompanying text provides context and explanation. We introduce DAGverse, a framework for constructing document-grounded semantic DAGs from online scientific papers. Its core component, DAGverse-Pipeline, is a semi-automatic system designed to produce high-precision semantic DAG examples through figure classification, graph reconstruction, semantic grounding, and validation. As a case study, we test the framework for causal DAGs and release DAGverse-1, a dataset of 108 expert-validated semantic DAGs with graph-level, node-level, and edge-level evidence. Experiments show that DAGverse-Pipeline outperforms existing Vision-Language Models on DAG classification and annotation. DAGverse provides a foundation for document-grounded DAG benchmarks and opens new directions for studying structured reasoning grounded in real-world evidence.

AI.tldr: DAGverse框架从科学论文中构建文档接地的语义有向无环图，通过半自动流程生成高质量数据集，在DAG分类和标注任务上优于现有视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的有向无环图数据集稀缺，因为构建它们需要专家对领域文档进行解释。文档可能允许多种合理的抽象，预期结构通常是隐含的，支持证据分散在文本、方程、标题和图表中。
AI.method: 利用包含明确DAG图表的科学论文作为监督源，提出DAGverse框架，其核心组件DAGverse-Pipeline是一个半自动系统，通过图表分类、图重建、语义接地和验证来构建文档接地的语义DAG。
AI.result: 发布了DAGverse-1数据集，包含108个专家验证的语义DAG，具有图级、节点级和边级证据。实验显示DAGverse-Pipeline在DAG分类和标注任务上优于现有视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: DAGverse为文档接地的DAG基准提供了基础，并为研究基于现实世界证据的结构化推理开辟了新方向。

title: Adaptive Chunking: Optimizing Chunking-Method Selection for RAG
comment: Accepted at LREC 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/ekimetrics/adaptive-chunking
summary: The effectiveness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly dependent on how documents are chunked, that is, segmented into smaller units for indexing and retrieval. Yet, commonly used "one-size-fits-all" approaches often fail to capture the nuanced structure and semantics of diverse texts. Despite its central role, chunking lacks a dedicated evaluation framework, making it difficult to assess and compare strategies independently of downstream performance. We challenge this paradigm by introducing Adaptive Chunking, a framework that selects the most suitable chunking strategy for each document based on a set of five novel intrinsic, document-based metrics: References Completeness (RC), Intrachunk Cohesion (ICC), Document Contextual Coherence (DCC), Block Integrity (BI), and Size Compliance (SC), which directly assess chunking quality across key dimensions. To support this framework, we also introduce two new chunkers, an LLM-regex splitter and a split-then-merge recursive splitter, alongside targeted post-processing techniques. On a diverse corpus spanning legal, technical, and social science domains, our metric-guided adaptive method significantly improves downstream RAG performance. Without changing models or prompts, our framework increases RAG outcomes, raising answers correctness to 72% (from 62-64%) and increasing the number of successfully answered questions by over 30% (65 vs. 49). These results demonstrate that adaptive, document-aware chunking, guided by a complementary suite of intrinsic metrics, offers a practical and effective path to more robust RAG systems. Code available at https://github.com/ekimetrics/adaptive-chunking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Adaptive Chunking框架，通过五个新颖的内在指标评估文档分块质量，并基于此选择最适合每个文档的分块策略，显著提升了RAG系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统的效果高度依赖文档分块策略，但常用的"一刀切"方法无法捕捉多样化文本的细微结构和语义。分块策略缺乏专门的评估框架，难以独立于下游任务评估和比较不同策略。
AI.method: 提出了Adaptive Chunking框架，包含五个新的内在文档指标：引用完整性、块内内聚性、文档上下文连贯性、块完整性、大小合规性。同时引入了两种新的分块器：LLM-正则表达式分割器和分割-合并递归分割器，以及针对性的后处理技术。
AI.result: 在涵盖法律、技术和社会科学领域的多样化语料库上，基于指标指导的自适应方法显著提升了RAG性能。在不改变模型或提示的情况下，答案正确率从62-64%提升到72%，成功回答的问题数量增加了30%以上（65 vs. 49）。
AI.conclusion: 基于互补的内在指标指导的、文档感知的自适应分块方法，为构建更健壮的RAG系统提供了实用有效的途径。

title: Evaluating Language Models for Harmful Manipulation
summary: Interest in the concept of AI-driven harmful manipulation is growing, yet current approaches to evaluating it are limited. This paper introduces a framework for evaluating harmful AI manipulation via context-specific human-AI interaction studies. We illustrate the utility of this framework by assessing an AI model with 10,101 participants spanning interactions in three AI use domains (public policy, finance, and health) and three locales (US, UK, and India). Overall, we find that that the tested model can produce manipulative behaviours when prompted to do so and, in experimental settings, is able to induce belief and behaviour changes in study participants. We further find that context matters: AI manipulation differs between domains, suggesting that it needs to be evaluated in the high-stakes context(s) in which an AI system is likely to be used. We also identify significant differences across our tested geographies, suggesting that AI manipulation results from one geographic region may not generalise to others. Finally, we find that the frequency of manipulative behaviours (propensity) of an AI model is not consistently predictive of the likelihood of manipulative success (efficacy), underscoring the importance of studying these dimensions separately. To facilitate adoption of our evaluation framework, we detail our testing protocols and make relevant materials publicly available. We conclude by discussing open challenges in evaluating harmful manipulation by AI models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个评估AI有害操纵行为的框架，通过跨领域（公共政策、金融、健康）和跨地区（美国、英国、印度）的大规模人机交互研究，发现AI模型确实能产生操纵行为并改变用户信念和行为，且这种操纵效果具有领域和地域特异性。
AI.motivation: 当前评估AI有害操纵的方法有限，需要开发更有效的评估框架来理解AI模型在不同情境下的操纵能力及其潜在危害。
AI.method: 提出基于情境的人机交互研究框架，在三个AI应用领域（公共政策、金融、健康）和三个地区（美国、英国、印度）对10,101名参与者进行实验，测试AI模型的操纵倾向和效果。
AI.result: 测试的AI模型在被提示时能产生操纵行为，并能改变参与者的信念和行为；操纵效果在不同领域和地区存在显著差异；模型的操纵倾向并不总能预测操纵成功率。
AI.conclusion: AI有害操纵评估需要在具体高风险情境中进行，且需分别考察操纵倾向和成功率；研究提供了公开的测试协议和材料，并讨论了该领域的开放挑战。

title: Large Language Model as Token Compressor and Decompressor
summary: In this paper, we establish the novel insight that an off-the-shelf LLM can function as an excellent token compressor and decompressor. To demonstrate, we design a self-expressive autoencoding learning framework fine-tunes a pretrained LLM to translate long texts into a compact internal language of discrete, variable-length latent codes, termed Z-tokens, and to reconstruct the original text exactly from them. The resulting representation is content-adaptive: semantically dense segments receive more Z-tokens, while redundant or predictable regions are aggressively compressed, via lightweight LoRA-based adapter heads. Empirically, our method achieves up to 18 times token reduction on Wikipedia, CNN/DailyMail, HotpotQA, and Qulac-style long-query datasets, while preserving reconstruction fidelity and downstream performance. This simple yet effective design supports applications including prompt compression and autoregressive generation directly in the Z-token space, offering a potential pathway toward token-efficient long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: LLM作为token压缩器/解压器，将长文本转换为紧凑的Z-token内部语言，实现高达18倍的token压缩，同时保持重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 解决长文本处理中的token效率问题，探索LLM作为内容自适应压缩器的潜力，为长上下文推理提供token高效方案。
AI.method: 设计自表达自编码学习框架，微调预训练LLM将长文本转换为离散、可变长度的Z-token潜在代码，使用轻量级LoRA适配器头实现内容自适应压缩。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia、CNN/DailyMail、HotpotQA和Qulac风格长查询数据集上实现高达18倍的token压缩，同时保持重建保真度和下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为优秀的token压缩器/解压器，Z-token表示支持提示压缩和Z-token空间自回归生成，为token高效的长上下文推理提供潜在途径。

title: Infinite Gaze Generation for Videos with Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Predicting human gaze in video is fundamental to advancing scene understanding and multimodal interaction. While traditional saliency maps provide spatial probability distributions and scanpaths offer ordered fixations, both abstractions often collapse the fine-grained temporal dynamics of raw gaze. Furthermore, existing models are typically constrained to short-term windows ($\approx$ 3-5s), failing to capture the long-range behavioral dependencies inherent in real-world content. We present a generative framework for infinite-horizon raw gaze prediction in videos of arbitrary length. By leveraging an autoregressive diffusion model, we synthesize gaze trajectories characterized by continuous spatial coordinates and high-resolution timestamps. Our model is conditioned on a saliency-aware visual latent space. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches in long-range spatio-temporal accuracy and trajectory realism.

AI.tldr: 提出基于自回归扩散模型的无限时域原始注视预测框架，用于任意长度视频中的连续时空注视轨迹生成
AI.motivation: 传统显著性图和扫描路径方法无法捕捉原始注视的细粒度时间动态，现有模型局限于短时间窗口（3-5秒），无法捕获真实世界内容中的长程行为依赖
AI.method: 使用自回归扩散模型生成具有连续空间坐标和高分辨率时间戳的注视轨迹，模型以显著性感知的视觉潜在空间为条件
AI.result: 定量和定性评估表明，该方法在长程时空准确性和轨迹真实性方面显著优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: 提出的生成框架能够有效预测任意长度视频中的无限时域原始注视，捕捉真实世界内容中的长程行为依赖关系

title: Macroscopic Characteristics of Mixed Traffic Flow with Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Automated and Human-Driven Vehicles
summary: Automated Vehicle (AV) control in mixed traffic, where AVs coexist with human-driven vehicles, poses significant challenges in balancing safety, efficiency, comfort, fuel efficiency, and compliance with traffic rules while capturing heterogeneous driver behavior. Traditional car-following models, such as the Intelligent Driver Model (IDM), often struggle to generalize across diverse traffic scenarios and typically do not account for fuel efficiency, motivating the use of learning-based approaches. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown strong microscopic performance in car-following conditions, its macroscopic traffic flow characteristics remain underexplored. This study focuses on analyzing the macroscopic traffic flow characteristics and fuel efficiency of DRL-based models in mixed traffic. A Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm is implemented for AVs' control and trained using the NGSIM highway dataset, enabling realistic interaction with human-driven vehicles. Traffic performance is evaluated using the Fundamental Diagram (FD) under varying driver heterogeneity, heterogeneous time-gap penetration levels, and different shares of RL-controlled vehicles. A macroscopic level comparison of fuel efficiency between the RL-based AV model and the IDM is also conducted. Results show that traffic performance is sensitive to the distribution of safe time gaps and the proportion of RL vehicles. Transitioning from fully human-driven to fully RL-controlled traffic can increase road capacity by approximately 7.52%. Further, RL-based AVs also improve average fuel efficiency by about 28.98% at higher speeds (above 50 km/h), and by 1.86% at lower speeds (below 50 km/h) compared to the IDM. Overall, the DRL framework enhances traffic capacity and fuel efficiency without compromising safety.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了基于深度强化学习的自动驾驶车辆在混合交通中的宏观交通流特性和燃油效率表现，发现相比传统IDM模型，DRL能提升道路容量约7.52%，并在高速时提高燃油效率约28.98%。
AI.motivation: 传统跟车模型（如IDM）难以泛化到多样化交通场景，且通常不考虑燃油效率。虽然深度强化学习在微观跟车性能上表现良好，但其宏观交通流特性尚未充分探索，因此需要研究DRL在混合交通中的宏观表现和燃油效率。
AI.method: 使用Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3)算法训练自动驾驶车辆控制策略，基于NGSIM高速公路数据集进行训练，使AV能与人类驾驶车辆进行真实交互。通过基本图(FD)评估不同驾驶员异质性、安全时距渗透水平和RL车辆比例下的交通性能，并与IDM模型进行宏观燃油效率对比。
AI.result: 交通性能对安全时距分布和RL车辆比例敏感。从完全人类驾驶过渡到完全RL控制交通可使道路容量增加约7.52%。RL-based AV在高速（50km/h以上）时平均燃油效率比IDM提高约28.98%，低速（50km/h以下）时提高1.86%。
AI.conclusion: 深度强化学习框架在不牺牲安全性的前提下，能够显著提升交通容量和燃油效率，为混合交通环境下的自动驾驶控制提供了有效解决方案。

title: TAPO: Translation Augmented Policy Optimization for Multilingual Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in English mathematical reasoning, yet a significant performance disparity persists in multilingual contexts, largely attributed to deficiencies in language understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Translation-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO), a novel reinforcement learning framework built upon GRPO. TAPO enforces an explicit alignment strategy where the model leverages English as a pivot and follows an understand-then-reason paradigm. Crucially, we employ a step-level relative advantage mechanism that decouples understanding from reasoning, allowing the integration of translation quality rewards without introducing optimization conflicts. Extensive experiments reveal that TAPO effectively synergizes language understanding with reasoning capabilities and is compatible with various models. It outperforms baseline methods in both multilingual mathematical reasoning and translation tasks, while generalizing well to unseen languages and out-of-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: TAPO是一个基于GRPO的强化学习框架，通过使用英语作为枢纽语言，采用理解-推理范式，解决LLMs在多语言数学推理中的性能差距问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在英语数学推理方面表现出色，但在多语言环境中存在显著的性能差距，主要原因是语言理解能力不足。
AI.method: 提出Translation-Augmented Policy Optimization (TAPO)框架，采用英语作为枢纽语言，遵循理解-推理范式，使用步骤级相对优势机制将理解与推理解耦，整合翻译质量奖励而不引入优化冲突。
AI.result: TAPO在多语言数学推理和翻译任务中均优于基线方法，能够很好地泛化到未见过的语言和领域外任务，并与多种模型兼容。
AI.conclusion: TAPO有效地将语言理解与推理能力协同起来，通过翻译增强的策略优化解决了多语言数学推理中的性能差距问题。

title: Beyond Attention Magnitude: Leveraging Inter-layer Rank Consistency for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in robotic manipulation but suffer from significant inference latency due to processing dense visual tokens. Existing token reduction methods predominantly rely on attention magnitude as a static selection. In this work, we challenge this assumption, revealing that high-attention tokens are task-dependent and can even degrade policy performance. To address this, we introduce \textbf{TIES} (\textbf{T}au-guided \textbf{I}nter-layer \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{S}election), a dynamic framework guided by inter-layer token ranking consistency. By adaptively balancing attention magnitude with ranking consistency, TIES ensures robust token selection without requiring additional training. On the CogACT + SIMPLER benchmark, TIES improves average success rates by 6\% while reducing token usage by 78\%, and demonstrate strong generalization across diverse decoders and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出TIES框架，通过动态平衡注意力大小与排名一致性，在减少78%视觉token的同时提升机器人操作成功率6%
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型推理延迟高，现有token缩减方法依赖静态注意力大小选择，但高注意力token具有任务依赖性，甚至可能降低策略性能
AI.method: 提出TIES框架，基于层间token排名一致性的动态选择机制，自适应平衡注意力大小与排名一致性，无需额外训练
AI.result: 在CogACT + SIMPLER基准上，平均成功率提升6%，token使用减少78%，在不同解码器和基准上表现出强泛化能力
AI.conclusion: TIES框架有效解决了VLA模型推理延迟问题，通过动态token选择机制在保持性能的同时显著减少计算开销

title: Agentic Trust Coordination for Federated Learning through Adaptive Thresholding and Autonomous Decision Making in Sustainable and Resilient Industrial Networks
summary:
Distributed intelligence in industrial networks increasingly integrates sensing, communication, and computation across heterogeneous and resource constrained devices. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training in such environments, but its reliability is affected by inconsistent client behaviour, noisy sensing conditions, and the presence of faulty or adversarial updates. Trust based mechanisms are commonly used to mitigate these effects, yet most remain statistical and heuristic, relying on fixed parameters or simple adaptive rules that struggle to accommodate changing operating conditions.
  This paper presents a lightweight agentic trust coordination approach for FL in sustainable and resilient industrial networks. The proposed Agentic Trust Control Layer operates as a server side control loop that observes trust related and system level signals, interprets their evolution over time, and applies targeted trust adjustments when instability is detected. The approach extends prior adaptive trust mechanisms by enabling context aware intervention decisions, rather than relying on fixed or purely reactive parameter updates. By explicitly separating observation, reasoning, and action, the proposed framework supports stable FL operation without modifying client side training or increasing communication overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级代理信任协调方法，用于可持续和弹性工业网络中的联邦学习。该方法通过服务器端控制循环观察信任相关和系统级信号，解释其随时间演变，并在检测到不稳定时应用有针对性的信任调整。
AI.motivation: 工业网络中的分布式智能日益集成异构和资源受限设备上的传感、通信和计算。联邦学习（FL）在此类环境中支持协作模型训练，但其可靠性受到客户端行为不一致、传感条件嘈杂以及存在故障或对抗性更新的影响。虽然基于信任的机制常用于缓解这些影响，但大多数仍然是统计和启发式的，依赖于固定参数或简单的自适应规则，难以适应不断变化的操作条件。
AI.method: 提出了一个轻量级代理信任协调方法，包括一个代理信任控制层，作为服务器端控制循环运行。该层观察信任相关和系统级信号，解释其随时间演变，并在检测到不稳定时应用有针对性的信任调整。该方法通过明确分离观察、推理和行动，支持稳定的FL操作，而无需修改客户端训练或增加通信开销。
AI.result: 该方法扩展了先前的自适应信任机制，实现了上下文感知的干预决策，而不是依赖固定或纯粹反应性的参数更新。通过将观察、推理和行动明确分离，所提出的框架支持稳定的FL操作，同时保持轻量级特性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的代理信任协调方法为工业网络中的联邦学习提供了一种有效的信任管理解决方案，能够适应动态变化的环境条件，提高FL系统的可靠性和稳定性，而无需增加系统开销或修改客户端实现。

title: Navigating the Prompt Space: Improving LLM Classification of Social Science Texts Through Prompt Engineering
summary: Recent developments in text classification using Large Language Models (LLMs) in the social sciences suggest that costs can be cut significantly, while performance can sometimes rival existing computational methods. However, with a wide variance in performance in current tests, we move to the question of how to maximize performance. In this paper, we focus on prompt context as a possible avenue for increasing accuracy by systematically varying three aspects of prompt engineering: label descriptions, instructional nudges, and few shot examples. Across two different examples, our tests illustrate that a minimal increase in prompt context yields the highest increase in performance, while further increases in context only tend to yield marginal performance increases thereafter. Alarmingly, increasing prompt context sometimes decreases accuracy. Furthermore, our tests suggest substantial heterogeneity across models, tasks, and batch size, underlining the need for individual validation of each LLM coding task rather than reliance on general rules.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在社会科学文本分类中使用大语言模型时，适度增加提示上下文能显著提升性能，但过度增加反而可能降低准确性，且不同模型、任务和批次大小存在显著异质性。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在社会科学文本分类中能显著降低成本且有时性能媲美现有计算方法，但当前测试中性能差异很大，因此需要研究如何最大化性能表现。
AI.method: 通过系统性地改变提示工程的三个方面：标签描述、指导性提示和少量样本示例，在两个不同案例中进行测试，研究提示上下文对性能的影响。
AI.result: 适度增加提示上下文能带来最高的性能提升，但进一步增加上下文通常只能带来边际改善，有时甚至降低准确性。不同模型、任务和批次大小之间存在显著异质性。
AI.conclusion: 每个大语言模型编码任务都需要单独验证，不能依赖通用规则，因为性能表现受多种因素影响且存在显著异质性。

title: BiFM: Bidirectional Flow Matching for Few-Step Image Editing and Generation
summary: Recent diffusion and flow matching models have demonstrated strong capabilities in image generation and editing by progressively removing noise through iterative sampling. While this enables flexible inversion for semantic-preserving edits, few-step sampling regimes suffer from poor forward process approximation, leading to degraded editing quality. Existing few-step inversion methods often rely on pretrained generators and auxiliary modules, limiting scalability and generalization across different architectures. To address these limitations, we propose BiFM (Bidirectional Flow Matching), a unified framework that jointly learns generation and inversion within a single model. BiFM directly estimates average velocity fields in both ``image $\to$ noise" and ``noise $\to$ image" directions, constrained by a shared instantaneous velocity field derived from either predefined schedules or pretrained multi-step diffusion models. Additionally, BiFM introduces a novel training strategy using continuous time-interval supervision, stabilized by a bidirectional consistency objective and a lightweight time-interval embedding. This bidirectional formulation also enables one-step inversion and can integrate seamlessly into popular diffusion and flow matching backbones. Across diverse image editing and generation tasks, BiFM consistently outperforms existing few-step approaches, achieving superior performance and editability.

AI.tldr: BiFM是一个双向流匹配框架，在单个模型中联合学习生成和反转过程，实现高质量少步图像编辑
AI.motivation: 现有少步采样方法存在前向过程近似差、编辑质量下降的问题，且通常依赖预训练生成器和辅助模块，限制了跨架构的可扩展性和泛化能力
AI.method: 提出BiFM框架，直接估计"图像→噪声"和"噪声→图像"两个方向的平均速度场，通过共享瞬时速度场约束，采用连续时间间隔监督训练策略，结合双向一致性目标和轻量级时间间隔嵌入
AI.result: 在多样化图像编辑和生成任务中，BiFM始终优于现有少步方法，实现了卓越的性能和可编辑性
AI.conclusion: BiFM提供了一个统一的框架，能够无缝集成到流行的扩散和流匹配骨干网络中，实现一步反转并提升少步编辑质量

title: 4OPS: Structural Difficulty Modeling in Integer Arithmetic Puzzles
summary:
Arithmetic puzzle games provide a controlled setting for studying difficulty in mathematical reasoning tasks, a core challenge in adaptive learning systems. We investigate the structural determinants of difficulty in a class of integer arithmetic puzzles inspired by number games. We formalize the problem and develop an exact dynamic-programming solver that enumerates reachable targets, extracts minimal-operation witnesses, and enables large-scale labeling.
